Interfaces:

- Consumes: `seeds` (Task 54); the seed bundles in `public/runtime/seeds/` (Task 54); `installHarness(core, post)` from `components/runtime/sandbox/harness.ts` (Task 49); `serializeValue`, `serializeError` (Task 44); `compilerOptions` and `runtime-globals.d.ts` (Task 12); `ConsoleFixture` (contract); `readSite(contentDir)` and `DocsPage` from `tools/repo-checks/src/docs/site.ts` (Task 25); `DOCS`, `CONTENT`, `FIXTURES` from `tools/repo-checks/src/docs/paths.ts` (Task 25); `readRegion` from `@nexusdi/doc-examples/regions` (Task 22).
- Produces:
  - `recordSeed(id: string, options?: { app?: string; coreDist?: string }): Promise<ConsoleFixture>` and the CLI `node tools/console-fixtures.mjs [--print <id>]` (writes `components/console/fixtures/<id with / as __>.json`, or prints one fixture)
  - Nx target `@nexusdi/docs:console-fixtures`, depending on `runtime-assets` and `playground-types`
  - `typeCheck(files, { compilerOptions, globals, root }): TypeDiagnostic[]` with `interface TypeDiagnostic { file: string; code: number; message: string }`
  - `checkSeedRegions`, `checkSeedIncludes`, `checkSeedTypes`, `checkSeedReferences`, `checkSeedFixtures`, `checkValibotVersions` in `tools/repo-checks/src/docs/doc-seeds.ts`

Every generated fixture sets `durationMs` to 0 (spec §10.3). The fixtures run the seeds in Node through `module.registerHooks`, which resolves `@ship/*` to the seed's emitted modules, `@nexusdi/core` to a bundle that installs the harness on the core build, and `valibot` to the pinned package.

- [ ] Step 2: Implement the recorder

`apps/docs/tools/console-fixtures.mjs`:

```js
import { mkdirSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { registerHooks } from 'node:module';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';

import { build } from 'esbuild';

/**
 * Runs every seed in Node against the workspace-built core and records what the
 * console shows for it (spec §10.3): `graph()`, the trace events, the console
 * output and any thrown error. Every `durationMs` is 0, so two builds write
 * identical HTML.
 *
 * The seed's modules are the ones `playground-types.mjs` emitted, so the Node
 * run and the browser run execute the same JavaScript.
 */

const app = join(import.meta.dirname, '..');
const root = join(app, '..', '..');
const SCHEME = 'nexus-seed:';

const sources = new Map();
let bundles = null;

registerHooks({
  resolve(specifier, context, next) {
    const parent = context.parentURL ?? '';
    if (parent.startsWith(SCHEME) || specifier.startsWith(SCHEME)) {
      const run = (specifier.startsWith(SCHEME) ? specifier : parent)
        .slice(SCHEME.length)
        .split('/')[0];
      const url = specifier.startsWith(SCHEME)
        ? specifier
        : `${SCHEME}${run}/${specifier}`;
      if (sources.has(url)) return { url, shortCircuit: true };
    }
    if (bundles && specifier === '@nexusdi/core')
      return { url: bundles.core, shortCircuit: true };
    if (bundles && specifier === '@nexusdi/core/testing')
      return { url: bundles.testing, shortCircuit: true };
    if (specifier === 'valibot') {
      return { url: import.meta.resolve('valibot'), shortCircuit: true };
    }
    return next(specifier, context);
  },
  load(url, context, next) {
    if (sources.has(url))
      return { format: 'module', source: sources.get(url), shortCircuit: true };
    return next(url, context);
  },
});

/**
 * Two bundles in a gitignored cache: one re-exports core with the harness
 * installed, one holds the serializer. Core stays external, so the testing
 * entry and the reader's code share one `Nexus` class, the one the harness
 * patched.
 */
async function prepare(coreDist) {
  const cache = join(app, '.console-fixtures');
  mkdirSync(cache, { recursive: true });
  const coreUrl = pathToFileURL(join(coreDist, 'index.js')).href;

  const coreEntry = [
    "import * as core from 'nexus-core-dist';",
    `import { installHarness } from ${JSON.stringify(join(app, 'components/runtime/sandbox/harness.ts'))};`,
    'installHarness(core, (body) => globalThis.__nexusFixture?.(body));',
    "export * from 'nexus-core-dist';",
  ].join('\n');

  const [coreOut, kitOut] = await Promise.all([
    build({
      stdin: { contents: coreEntry, resolveDir: app, loader: 'ts' },
      bundle: true,
      format: 'esm',
      platform: 'node',
      external: ['nexus-core-dist'],
      write: false,
    }),
    build({
      entryPoints: [join(app, 'components/runtime/serialize.ts')],
      bundle: true,
      format: 'esm',
      platform: 'node',
      write: false,
    }),
  ]);

  const corePath = join(cache, 'core.mjs');
  writeFileSync(
    corePath,
    coreOut.outputFiles[0].text.replaceAll(
      '"nexus-core-dist"',
      JSON.stringify(coreUrl),
    ),
  );
  const kitPath = join(cache, 'serialize.mjs');
  writeFileSync(kitPath, kitOut.outputFiles[0].text);

  const testingPath = join(cache, 'testing.mjs');
  writeFileSync(
    testingPath,
    `export * from ${JSON.stringify(pathToFileURL(join(coreDist, 'testing', 'index.js')).href)};\n`,
  );

  bundles = {
    core: pathToFileURL(corePath).href,
    testing: pathToFileURL(testingPath).href,
  };
  return import(pathToFileURL(kitPath).href);
}

function readBundle(id) {
  const runtime = join(app, 'public', 'runtime');
  const index = JSON.parse(
    readFileSync(join(runtime, 'seeds', 'index.json'), 'utf8'),
  );
  if (!index[id])
    throw new Error(
      `No seed named ${id} exists. Add it to components/runtime/seeds.ts.`,
    );
  return JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(runtime, index[id]), 'utf8'));
}

function zeroDurations(event) {
  return 'durationMs' in event ? { ...event, durationMs: 0 } : event;
}

let runs = 0;
let kit = null;

export async function recordSeed(id, options = {}) {
  const coreDist =
    options.coreDist ??
    process.env.DOCS_CORE_DIST ??
    join(root, 'libs', 'core', 'dist');
  kit ??= await prepare(coreDist);
  const bundle = readBundle(id);

  runs += 1;
  const run = `run${runs}`;
  for (const module of Object.values(bundle.modules)) {
    sources.set(`${SCHEME}${run}/${module.specifier}`, module.js);
  }

  const fixture = {
    seed: id,
    graph: null,
    trace: [],
    console: [],
    error: null,
  };
  const levels = ['log', 'info', 'warn', 'error'];
  const original = Object.fromEntries(
    levels.map((level) => [level, console[level]]),
  );

  globalThis.__guard ??= () => undefined;
  globalThis.__nexusFixture = (body) => {
    if (body.type === 'trace') fixture.trace.push(zeroDurations(body.event));
    if (body.type === 'graph') fixture.graph = body.graph;
    if (body.type === 'error' && fixture.error === null) {
      const { type: _type, phase: _phase, ...error } = body;
      fixture.error = error;
    }
  };
  for (const level of levels) {
    console[level] = (...args) =>
      fixture.console.push({
        level,
        args: args.map((arg) => kit.serializeValue(arg)),
      });
  }

  try {
    await import(`${SCHEME}${run}/${bundle.modules[bundle.entry].specifier}`);
    await new Promise((settle) => setTimeout(settle, 0));
  } catch (error) {
    fixture.error ??= kit.serializeError(error);
  } finally {
    for (const level of levels) console[level] = original[level];
    delete globalThis.__nexusFixture;
  }

  return fixture;
}

export function fixtureFile(id) {
  return join(
    app,
    'components',
    'console',
    'fixtures',
    `${id.replaceAll('/', '__')}.json`,
  );
}

async function main() {
  const at = process.argv.indexOf('--print');
  if (at !== -1) {
    process.stdout.write(
      JSON.stringify(await recordSeed(process.argv[at + 1])),
    );
    return;
  }
  const index = JSON.parse(
    readFileSync(join(app, 'public', 'runtime', 'seeds', 'index.json'), 'utf8'),
  );
  mkdirSync(join(app, 'components', 'console', 'fixtures'), {
    recursive: true,
  });
  for (const id of Object.keys(index)) {
    writeFileSync(
      fixtureFile(id),
      `${JSON.stringify(await recordSeed(id), null, 2)}\n`,
    );
  }
  console.log(`wrote ${Object.keys(index).length} console fixtures`);
}

if (import.meta.url === pathToFileURL(process.argv[1] ?? '').href) {
  main().catch((error) => {
    console.error(error instanceof Error ? error.message : error);
    process.exit(1);
  });
}
```

```ts
import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { existsSync, readdirSync, readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';

import { workspaceRoot } from '@nx/devkit';
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';

import {
  checkSeedFixtures,
  checkSeedIncludes,
  checkSeedReferences,
  checkSeedRegions,
  checkSeedTypes,
  checkValibotVersions,
  includeGlobsFor,
  primeIncludeGlobs,
  type SeedRegistry,
} from './docs/doc-seeds';
import { CONTENT, DOCS, FIXTURES } from './docs/paths';
import { readSite } from './docs/site';

const clean = join(FIXTURES, 'doc-seeds', 'clean');
const sabotaged = (name: string) =>
  join(FIXTURES, 'doc-seeds', 'sabotaged', name);

const registry: SeedRegistry = {
  'demo/hello': {
    files: [
      { path: 'main.ts', file: 'examples/demo/src/hello.ts', region: 'hello' },
    ],
    entry: 'main.ts',
  },
};

async function typeOptions() {
  const module = (await import(
    pathToFileURL(join(DOCS, 'components/runtime/compiler-options.ts')).href
  )) as { compilerOptions: Record<string, unknown> };
  return {
    compilerOptions: { ...module.compilerOptions },
    globals: readFileSync(
      join(DOCS, 'components/runtime/runtime-globals.d.ts'),
      'utf8',
    ),
  };
}

describe('doc-seeds fixtures', () => {
  it('passes a clean tree', async () => {
    const options = await typeOptions();
    expect(checkSeedRegions(clean, registry)).toEqual([]);
    expect(
      checkSeedIncludes(registry, () => ['examples/demo/src/**/*.ts']),
    ).toEqual([]);
    expect(
      checkSeedTypes(clean, registry, { ...options, root: workspaceRoot }),
    ).toEqual([]);
    expect(
      checkSeedReferences(registry, readSite(join(clean, 'content'))),
    ).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('fails a region that does not exist', () => {
    const findings = checkSeedRegions(clean, {
      'demo/hello': {
        files: [

            path: 'main.ts',

      },
    });

    expect(findings[0]).toContain('absent');
  });

  it('fails a file outside every Vitest include set', () => {
    expect(checkSeedIncludes(registry, () => ['src/**/*.test.ts'])).toEqual([
      expect.stringContaining('examples/demo/src/hello.ts'),
    ]);
  });

  it('fails a seed that does not type-check', async () => {
    const findings = checkSeedTypes(sabotaged('type-error'), registry, {
      ...(await typeOptions()),
      root: workspaceRoot,
    });
    expect(findings).toEqual([expect.stringContaining('TS2322')]);
```

`tools/repo-checks/src/docs/type-check.ts`:

```ts
import { join, relative } from 'node:path';

import ts from 'typescript';

export interface TypeDiagnostic {
  file: string;
  code: number;
  message: string;
}

/**
 * Type-checks in-memory files with the playground's compiler options and its
 * ambient globals, the environment the worker and the twoslash prelude share
 * (spec §11.2). The files sit in a virtual directory under `root`, so a bare
 * `@nexusdi/core` resolves through the workspace's `node_modules`.
 */
export function typeCheck(
  files: Record<string, string>,
  options: {
    compilerOptions: Record<string, unknown>;
    globals: string;
    root: string;
  },
): TypeDiagnostic[] {
  const converted = ts.convertCompilerOptionsFromJson(
    { ...options.compilerOptions, noEmit: true, sourceMap: false },
    options.root,
  );
  if (converted.errors.length > 0) {
    throw new Error(
      converted.errors
        .map((error) =>
          ts.flattenDiagnosticMessageText(error.messageText, '\n'),
        )
        .join('\n'),
    );
  }

  const dir = join(options.root, '__nexus_seed__');
  const virtual = new Map<string, string>(
    Object.entries(files).map(([path, source]) => [join(dir, path), source]),
  );
  virtual.set(join(dir, 'runtime-globals.d.ts'), options.globals);

  const host = ts.createCompilerHost(converted.options);
  const getSourceFile = host.getSourceFile.bind(host);
  host.getSourceFile = (fileName, language, ...rest) => {
    const source = virtual.get(fileName);
    return source === undefined
      ? getSourceFile(fileName, language, ...rest)
      : ts.createSourceFile(fileName, source, language);
  };
  host.fileExists = (fileName) =>
    virtual.has(fileName) || ts.sys.fileExists(fileName);
  host.readFile = (fileName) =>
    virtual.get(fileName) ?? ts.sys.readFile(fileName);

  const program = ts.createProgram(
    [...virtual.keys()],
    converted.options,
    host,
  );

  return ts
    .getPreEmitDiagnostics(program)
    .filter(
      (diagnostic) => !diagnostic.file || virtual.has(diagnostic.file.fileName),
    )
    .map((diagnostic) => ({
      file: diagnostic.file
        ? relative(dir, diagnostic.file.fileName)
        : '(compiler options)',
      code: diagnostic.code,
      message: ts.flattenDiagnosticMessageText(diagnostic.messageText, '\n'),
    }));
}
```

```ts
import { existsSync, readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { dirname, join, matchesGlob, relative } from 'node:path';
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';

import { readRegion } from '@nexusdi/doc-examples/regions';

import type { DocsPage } from './site';
import { typeCheck } from './type-check';

export interface SeedFile {
  path: string;
  file: string;
  region: string;
}

export interface Seed {
  files: SeedFile[];
  entry: string;
}

export type SeedRegistry = Record<string, Seed>;

const FIX =
  'The registry is apps/docs/components/runtime/seeds.ts (spec §11.9).';

function regionCode(root: string, file: SeedFile): string {
  return readRegion(
    readFileSync(join(root, file.file), 'utf8'),
    file.file,
    file.region,
  ).code;
}

/** Every file of every seed names a region that exists. */
export function checkSeedRegions(root: string, seeds: SeedRegistry): string[] {
  const findings: string[] = [];
  for (const [id, seed] of Object.entries(seeds)) {
    for (const file of seed.files) {
      try {
        regionCode(root, file);
      } catch (error) {
        findings.push(
          `seed '${id}': ${file.file} has no region '${file.region}' (${
            error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)
          }). Add the region or fix the seed. ${FIX}`,
        );
      }
    }
  }
  return findings;
}

/**
 * Every file a seed reads sits in a Vitest project's include set, so the code
 * the editor starts on is code a test ran.
 */
export function checkSeedIncludes(
  seeds: SeedRegistry,
  globsFor: (file: string) => string[] | null,
): string[] {
  const findings: string[] = [];
  for (const [id, seed] of Object.entries(seeds)) {
    for (const file of seed.files) {
      const globs = globsFor(file.file) ?? [];
      if (!globs.some((glob) => matchesGlob(file.file, glob))) {
        findings.push(
          `seed '${id}': ${file.file} is in no Vitest include or includeSource set, so no test runs it. ` +
            `Move the region into a collected file.`,
        );
      }
    }
  }
  return findings;
}

/** The include globs of the project that holds `file`, workspace-relative. */
export async function includeGlobsForAsync(
  root: string,
  file: string,
): Promise<string[] | null> {
  let dir = dirname(join(root, file));
  while (dir.startsWith(root) && !existsSync(join(dir, 'vite.config.ts')))
    dir = dirname(dir);
  if (!existsSync(join(dir, 'vite.config.ts'))) return null;

  const module = (await import(
    pathToFileURL(join(dir, 'vite.config.ts')).href
  )) as {
    default:
      | ((env: { command: 'serve'; mode: string }) => {
          test?: { include?: string[]; includeSource?: string[] };
        })
      | { test?: { include?: string[]; includeSource?: string[] } };
  };
  const config =
    typeof module.default === 'function'
      ? module.default({ command: 'serve', mode: 'test' })
      : module.default;
  const project = relative(root, dir);
  return [
    ...(config.test?.include ?? []),
    ...(config.test?.includeSource ?? []),
  ].map((glob) => `${project}/${glob}`);
}

const globCache = new Map<string, string[] | null>();

/**
 * The synchronous face `checkSeedIncludes` takes. The live test fills the
 * cache first with `primeIncludeGlobs`.
 */
export function includeGlobsFor(_root: string, file: string): string[] | null {
  return globCache.get(file) ?? null;
}

export async function primeIncludeGlobs(
  root: string,
  seeds: SeedRegistry,
): Promise<void> {
  for (const seed of Object.values(seeds)) {
    for (const file of seed.files) {
      globCache.set(file.file, await includeGlobsForAsync(root, file.file));
    }
  }
}

/** Every seed type-checks in the playground's environment. */
export function checkSeedTypes(
  root: string,
  seeds: SeedRegistry,
  options: {
    compilerOptions: Record<string, unknown>;
    globals: string;
    root: string;
  },
): string[] {
  const findings: string[] = [];
  for (const [id, seed] of Object.entries(seeds)) {
    let files: Record<string, string>;
    try {
      files = Object.fromEntries(
        seed.files.map((file) => [file.path, regionCode(root, file)]),
      );
    } catch {
      continue; // checkSeedRegions reports a missing region.
    }
    for (const diagnostic of typeCheck(files, options)) {
      findings.push(
        `seed '${id}': ${diagnostic.file} does not type-check: TS${diagnostic.code} ${diagnostic.message}`,
      );
    }
  }
  return findings;
}

const CONSOLE_VIEW = /<ConsoleView\b[^>]*\bseed="([^"]+)"/g;
const PLAYGROUND_LINK = /\/playground\/\?seed=([\w/-]+)/g;

/** Every ConsoleView and every Playground link names a registered seed. */
export function checkSeedReferences(
  seeds: SeedRegistry,
  pages: DocsPage[],
): string[] {
  const findings: string[] = [];
  for (const page of pages) {
    for (const pattern of [CONSOLE_VIEW, PLAYGROUND_LINK]) {
      for (const [, id] of page.source.matchAll(pattern)) {
        if (id && !(id in seeds)) {
          findings.push(
            `${page.file}: names seed '${id}', which is not registered. ${FIX}`,
          );
        }
      }
    }
  }
  return findings;
}

/** The stored console fixture of every seed is what the seed produces now. */
export function checkSeedFixtures(
  stored: Record<string, unknown>,
  recorded: Record<string, unknown>,
): string[] {
  return Object.keys(recorded)
    .filter((id) => JSON.stringify(stored[id]) !== JSON.stringify(recorded[id]))
    .map(
      (id) =>
        `seed '${id}': the console fixture differs from a fresh run. Run ` +
        '`npx nx run @nexusdi/docs:console-fixtures` after rebuilding core.',
    );
}

/** examples/meridian, apps/docs and the runtime path carry one valibot version. */
export function checkValibotVersions(versions: {
  examples: string;
  docs: string;
  runtime: string;
}): string[] {
  const runtime = versions.runtime.replace(/^valibot-/, '');
  const all = [versions.examples, versions.docs, runtime];
  return new Set(all).size === 1 && versions.examples !== ''
    ? []
    : [
        `valibot versions disagree: examples/meridian ${versions.examples}, apps/docs ${versions.docs}, ` +
          `runtime path ${versions.runtime}. Bump all three in one pull request.`,
      ];
}
```

```ts
/** One editor file of a mission variant, read from a doctested region. */
export interface MissionFile {
  path: string;
  file: string;
  region: string;
}

export interface MissionFiles {
  files: MissionFile[];
  entry: string;
}

/** The part of a trace event a check can rely on before the engine merges. */
export interface TraceEventLike {
  type: string;
}

export interface CheckContext {
  /**
   * The container `main.ts` exports. Typed loosely until the 0.4 engine
   * publishes `Nexus`; Task 68 narrows it.
   */
  // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
  ship: any;
  exports: Record<string, unknown>;
  trace: readonly TraceEventLike[];
  core: { core: unknown; testing: unknown };
}

export type CheckResult =
  { status: 'pass' } | { status: 'fail'; message: string };

export type Check = (
  context: CheckContext,
) => CheckResult | Promise<CheckResult>;

/** A known-wrong solution that its objective must fail (spec §14.4). */
export interface Decoy {
  name: string;
  files: MissionFile[];
}

export interface Objective {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  teaches: boolean;
  guided: boolean;
  check: Check;
  decoys: Decoy[];
}

export interface Hint {
  id: string;
  objectiveId: string;
  text: string;
}

/** `apps/docs/academy/<id>/mission.ts` (spec §13.2). */
export interface Mission {
  id: string;
  version: number;
  title: string;
  practises: string;
  layout: 'guided' | 'briefing';
  carries: string[];
  replaces: string[];
  seed: MissionFiles;
  seedDiagnostics: number[];
  solution: MissionFiles;
  reads: string[];
  objectives: Objective[];
  hints: Hint[];
}
```

`tools/repo-checks/src/docs/mission-runner.mjs`:

```js
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { registerHooks } from 'node:module';
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';

/**
 * Runs one variant of one mission (seed, solution or a decoy) in a fresh Node
 * process, so every variant gets a fresh module graph (spec §14.4 step 2).
 *
 * Input: a JSON file named by the first argument, holding
 * `{ missionFile, modules: { [path]: { specifier, js } }, objectiveIds, limitMs }`.
 * Output on stdout: `{ exports: string[], results: [...] }`.
 */

const input = JSON.parse(readFileSync(process.argv[2], 'utf8'));
const PREFIX = 'nexus-seed:run/';
const sources = new Map(
  Object.values(input.modules).map((module) => [
    `${PREFIX}${module.specifier}`,
    module.js,
  ]),
);

registerHooks({
  resolve(specifier, context, next) {
    const url = specifier.startsWith(PREFIX)
      ? specifier
      : `${PREFIX}${specifier}`;
    if (sources.has(url)) return { url, shortCircuit: true };
    return next(specifier, context);
  },
  load(url, context, next) {
    if (sources.has(url))
      return { format: 'module', source: sources.get(url), shortCircuit: true };
    return next(url, context);
  },
});

// The transformer puts a guard call in every loop and function body. The
// 5-second limit below ends a check here, and the browser's guard is Task 45's.
globalThis.__guard = () => undefined;

const exports = {};
for (const url of sources.keys()) Object.assign(exports, await import(url));

const { default: mission } = await import(
  pathToFileURL(input.missionFile).href
);

let core = null;
let testing = null;
try {
  core = await import('@nexusdi/core');
  testing = await import('@nexusdi/core/testing');
} catch {
  // No built core: checks that read `core` fail with their own message.
}

const results = [];
for (const objective of mission.objectives) {
  if (!input.objectiveIds.includes(objective.id)) continue;
  const started = performance.now();
  let timedOut = false;
  let result;
  try {
    result = await Promise.race([
      Promise.resolve(
        objective.check({
          ship: exports.ship,
          exports,
          trace: [],
          core: { core, testing },
        }),
      ),
      new Promise((_, reject) => {
        setTimeout(() => {
          timedOut = true;
          reject(new Error(`The check ran past ${input.limitMs} ms.`));
        }, input.limitMs).unref();
      }),
    ]);
  } catch (error) {
    result = {
      status: 'fail',
      message:
        error instanceof Error
          ? `${error.name}: ${error.message}`
          : String(error),
    };
  }
  results.push({
    objectiveId: objective.id,
    status: result.status,
    message: result.message ?? '',
    ms: Math.round(performance.now() - started),
    timedOut,
  });
}

process.stdout.write(
  JSON.stringify({ exports: Object.keys(exports), results }),
);
process.exit(0);
```

- [ ] Step 6: Implement the guard

`tools/repo-checks/src/docs/academy-missions.ts`:

```ts
import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process';
import {
  existsSync,
  mkdtempSync,
  readdirSync,
  readFileSync,
  writeFileSync,
} from 'node:fs';
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os';
import { join } from 'node:path';
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url';

import { readRegion } from '@nexusdi/doc-examples/regions';
import { workspaceRoot } from '@nx/devkit';
import ts from 'typescript';

import type {
  Mission,
  MissionFile,
} from '../../../../apps/docs/components/academy/mission-types';
import { DOCS } from './paths';
import { typeCheck, type TypeDiagnostic } from './type-check';

export const CHECK_LIMIT_MS = 5_000;
const RUNNER = join(import.meta.dirname, 'mission-runner.mjs');

export interface RunResult {
  objectiveId: string;
  status: 'pass' | 'fail';
  message: string;
  ms: number;
  timedOut: boolean;
}

export interface MissionDeps {
  typeCheck(files: Record<string, string>): TypeDiagnostic[];
  transpile(
    files: Record<string, string>,
  ): Record<string, { specifier: string; js: string }>;
  run(
    missionFile: string,
    modules: Record<string, { specifier: string; js: string }>,
    objectiveIds: string[],
  ): {
    exports: string[];
    results: RunResult[];
  };
}

export async function loadMissionDeps(): Promise<MissionDeps> {
  const { compilerOptions } = (await import(
    pathToFileURL(join(DOCS, 'components/runtime/compiler-options.ts')).href
  )) as { compilerOptions: Record<string, unknown> };
  const { transpileRun } = (await import(
    pathToFileURL(join(DOCS, 'components/runtime/transform.ts')).href
  )) as {
    transpileRun: (
      compiler: typeof ts,
      files: Record<string, string>,
    ) => Record<string, { specifier: string; js: string }>;
  };
  const globals = readFileSync(
    join(DOCS, 'components/runtime/runtime-globals.d.ts'),
    'utf8',
  );

  return {
    typeCheck: (files) =>
      typeCheck(files, {
        compilerOptions: { ...compilerOptions },
        globals,
        root: workspaceRoot,
      }),
    transpile: (files) => transpileRun(ts, files),
    run(missionFile, modules, objectiveIds) {
      const dir = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'nexus-mission-'));
      const inputFile = join(dir, 'input.json');
      writeFileSync(
        inputFile,
        JSON.stringify({
          missionFile,
          modules,
          objectiveIds,
          limitMs: CHECK_LIMIT_MS,
        }),
      );
      const output = execFileSync(process.execPath, [RUNNER, inputFile], {
        encoding: 'utf8',
        timeout: CHECK_LIMIT_MS * (objectiveIds.length + 1) + 10_000,
      });
      return JSON.parse(output) as { exports: string[]; results: RunResult[] };
    },
  };
}

function read(root: string, files: MissionFile[]): Record<string, string> {
  return Object.fromEntries(
    files.map((file) => [
      file.path,
      readRegion(
        readFileSync(join(root, file.file), 'utf8'),
        file.file,
        file.region,
      ).code,
    ]),
  );
}

function sameSet(a: number[], b: number[]): boolean {
  const left = [...new Set(a)].sort((x, y) => x - y);
  const right = [...new Set(b)].sort((x, y) => x - y);
  return JSON.stringify(left) === JSON.stringify(right);
}

/**
 * The mission guard (spec §14.4). A mission whose seed passes what it claims
 * to teach, whose solution fails, or whose decoy passes is a mission that
 * teaches nothing, and each fails CI here.
 */
export async function checkMissions(
  missionsDir: string,
  root: string,
  deps: MissionDeps,
): Promise<string[]> {
  if (!existsSync(missionsDir)) return [];

  const ids = readdirSync(missionsDir, { withFileTypes: true })
    .filter(
      (entry) =>
        entry.isDirectory() &&
        existsSync(join(missionsDir, entry.name, 'mission.ts')),
    )
    .map((entry) => entry.name)
    .sort();

  const findings: string[] = [];
  let previous: { mission: Mission; solution: Record<string, string> } | null =
    null;

  for (const id of ids) {
    const missionFile = join(missionsDir, id, 'mission.ts');
    const { default: mission } = (await import(
      pathToFileURL(missionFile).href
    )) as { default: Mission };
    const objectiveIds = mission.objectives.map((objective) => objective.id);
    const seed = read(root, mission.seed.files);
    const solution = read(root, mission.solution.files);

    // 1. The solution type-checks; the seed produces exactly seedDiagnostics.
    for (const diagnostic of deps.typeCheck(solution)) {
      findings.push(
        `${id}: the solution does not type-check: TS${diagnostic.code} in ${diagnostic.file}.`,
      );
    }
    const seedCodes = deps.typeCheck(seed).map((diagnostic) => diagnostic.code);
    if (!sameSet(seedCodes, mission.seedDiagnostics)) {
      findings.push(
        `${id}: the seed produces TypeScript codes [${seedCodes.join(', ')}] and seedDiagnostics lists ` +
          `[${mission.seedDiagnostics.join(', ')}]. Make the two agree.`,
      );
    }

    // 2. Every objective the mission teaches fails on the seed, with a message.
    const seedRun = deps.run(missionFile, deps.transpile(seed), objectiveIds);
    for (const objective of mission.objectives.filter((each) => each.teaches)) {
      const result = seedRun.results.find(
        (each) => each.objectiveId === objective.id,
      );
      if (result?.status !== 'fail') {
        findings.push(
          `${id}: the seed passes '${objective.id}', which the mission claims to teach.`,
        );
      } else if (result.message.trim() === '') {
        findings.push(
          `${id}: '${objective.id}' fails on the seed with an empty message.`,
        );
      }
    }

    // 3. Every objective passes on the solution.
    const solutionRun = deps.run(
      missionFile,
      deps.transpile(solution),
      objectiveIds,
    );
    for (const result of solutionRun.results.filter(
      (each) => each.status !== 'pass',
    )) {
      findings.push(
        `${id}: the solution fails '${result.objectiveId}': ${result.message}`,
      );
    }

    // 4. Each decoy fails its objective.
    for (const objective of mission.objectives) {
      for (const decoy of objective.decoys) {
        const files = { ...solution, ...read(root, decoy.files) };
        const decoyRun = deps.run(missionFile, deps.transpile(files), [
          objective.id,
        ]);
        if (decoyRun.results[0]?.status === 'pass') {
          findings.push(
            `${id}: the decoy '${decoy.name}' passes '${objective.id}'. The check is too weak; ` +
              'strengthen it and keep the decoy.',
          );
        }
      }
    }

    // 5. Every check finishes inside the browser's limit.
    for (const result of [...seedRun.results, ...solutionRun.results].filter(
      (each) => each.timedOut,
    )) {
      findings.push(
        `${id}: '${result.objectiveId}' ran past ${CHECK_LIMIT_MS} ms.`,
      );
    }

    // 6. Carried files equal the previous mission's solution.
    if (previous) {
      for (const path of mission.carries) {
        if (seed[path] !== previous.solution[path]) {
          findings.push(
            `${id}: carries '${path}', which differs from ${previous.mission.id}'s solution. ` +
              `Copy the file from that solution or list it in replaces.`,
          );
        }
      }
    }

    // 7. The solution exports every name a check reads.
    for (const name of mission.reads.filter(
      (each) => !solutionRun.exports.includes(each),
    )) {
      findings.push(
        `${id}: a check reads '${name}', and the solution does not export it.`,
      );
    }

    previous = { mission, solution };
  }

  return findings;
}
```

The `solution-fails` test uses `toContainEqual`, because a failing solution can also produce a check 7 finding when it stops exporting a name.

## Group H: The ship console

This group turns core's `graph()` JSON and trace events into the console a concept page shows: a layered graph layout, the SVG graph view, the trace replay, the error view, and the widget composition with section tracking and view transitions. Every view renders from hand-written fixture JSON until the engine merges (Task 68), and every view renders on the server, so a reader without JavaScript sees the final state.

```ts
// The shapes core's `graph()` and `trace` callback produce, copied from
// specs/2026-09-23-core-0.4-design.md §10 at b5ab435. Task 68 replaces this
// file's body with `export type { ... } from '@nexusdi/core'` once the engine
// exports them.

export type Lifetime = 'singleton' | 'scoped' | 'transient';

export interface NexusGraph {
  modules: Array<{
    id: string; // 'm0'
    name: string;
    global: boolean;
    imports: string[]; // module ids
    exports: string[]; // provider ids and module ids
  }>;
  providers: Array<{
    id: string; // 'p0'
    token: string; // display name
    module: string; // module id
    lifetime: 'singleton' | 'scoped' | 'transient' | null; // null for value and alias
    kind: 'class' | 'value' | 'factory' | 'alias';
    async: boolean | null; // factories: whether the last build returned a thenable; null before any build
  }>;
  edges: Array<{
    from: string; // provider id
    to: string; // provider id
    kind: 'required' | 'optional' | 'lazy' | 'all' | 'alias';
  }>;
}

export type TraceEvent =
  | {
      type: 'compile';
      phase: 'create' | 'load';
      modules: number;
      providers: number;
      errors: number;
      durationMs: number;
    }
  | {
      type: 'construct';
      token: string;
      providerId: string;
      module: string;
      lifetime: Lifetime | null; // null for value and alias providers
      scope: string | null;
      async: boolean;
      durationMs: number;
    }
  | {
      type: 'untracked';
      token: string;
      providerId: string;
      reason: 'root-transient' | 'singleton-thunk';
    }
  | { type: 'init'; token: string; providerId: string; durationMs: number }
  | { type: 'scope:create'; scope: string; built: number; durationMs: number }
  | {
      type: 'scope:dispose';
      scope: string;
      disposed: number;
      errors: number;
      durationMs: number;
    }
  | {
      type: 'dispose:instance';
      token: string;
      providerId: string;
      scope: string | null; // null for root-owned instances
    }
  | { type: 'dispose'; disposed: number; errors: number; durationMs: number };
```

```ts
    .sort((a, b) => a.key - b.key)
```

- [ ] Step 6: Implement the layout

`apps/docs/components/graph/layout.ts`:

```ts
import type { NexusGraph } from './types';

/**
 * The layered layout of spec §12.1, by the docs' own rule.
 *
 * A provider's layer is the length of the longest path from it to a provider
 * with no dependencies, over every edge kind except `lazy`. Layer 0 sits at the
 * bottom, so a consumer draws above what it depends on. Four barycenter sweeps
 * order each layer, and ties break by provider id, so one graph always draws
 * one way. A lazy edge routes as a curve through a lane to the right of the
 * layers, which makes a cycle broken by `lazy()` read as a loop with one soft
 * link.
 */

export const NODE_WIDTH = 176;
export const NODE_HEIGHT = 60;
export const GAP_X = 32;
export const GAP_Y = 80;
export const MARGIN = 24;
export const LAZY_LANE = 64;
const SWEEPS = 4;

type Provider = NexusGraph['providers'][number];
type Edge = NexusGraph['edges'][number];

export interface LaidNode {
  id: string;
  token: string;
  module: string;
  moduleName: string;
  lifetime: Provider['lifetime'];
  kind: Provider['kind'];
  async: boolean | null;
  layer: number;
  order: number;
  x: number;
  y: number;
}

export interface LaidEdge {
  from: string;
  to: string;
  kind: Edge['kind'];
  d: string;
  outside: boolean;
  mid: { x: number; y: number };
}

export interface GraphLayout {
  nodes: LaidNode[];
  edges: LaidEdge[];
  width: number;
  height: number;
}

/** Provider ids compare as `p2` before `p10`. */
function byId(a: string, b: string): number {
  return a.localeCompare(b, 'en', { numeric: true });
}

function round(value: number): number {
  return Math.round(value * 10) / 10;
}

export function layoutGraph(graph: NexusGraph): GraphLayout {
  const providers = [...graph.providers].sort((a, b) => byId(a.id, b.id));

  if (providers.length === 0) {
    return { nodes: [], edges: [], width: MARGIN * 2, height: MARGIN * 2 };
  }

  const known = new Set(providers.map((provider) => provider.id));
  const edges = graph.edges
    .filter((edge) => known.has(edge.from) && known.has(edge.to))
    .sort(
      (a, b) =>
        byId(a.from, b.from) ||
        byId(a.to, b.to) ||
        a.kind.localeCompare(b.kind),
    );
  const layered = edges.filter(
    (edge) => edge.kind !== 'lazy' && edge.from !== edge.to,
  );

  const dependencies = new Map<string, string[]>(
    providers.map((provider) => [provider.id, []]),
  );
  const neighbours = new Map<string, string[]>(
    providers.map((provider) => [provider.id, []]),
  );
  for (const edge of layered) {
    dependencies.get(edge.from)!.push(edge.to);
    neighbours.get(edge.from)!.push(edge.to);
    neighbours.get(edge.to)!.push(edge.from);
  }

  // Longest path to a leaf. `visiting` stops a cycle with no lazy edge, which
  // core reports as NEXUS_CIRCULAR_DEPENDENCY before any graph exists; a stale
  // fixture can still hold one, and the layout must terminate on it.
  const layer = new Map<string, number>();
  const visiting = new Set<string>();
  const depth = (id: string): number => {
    const settled = layer.get(id);
    if (settled !== undefined) return settled;
    if (visiting.has(id)) return 0;
    visiting.add(id);
    let longest = 0;
    for (const to of dependencies.get(id) ?? []) {
      longest = Math.max(longest, depth(to) + 1);
    }
    visiting.delete(id);
    layer.set(id, longest);
    return longest;
  };
  for (const provider of providers) depth(provider.id);

  const top = Math.max(...layer.values());
  const rows: string[][] = Array.from({ length: top + 1 }, () => []);
  for (const provider of providers)
    rows[layer.get(provider.id)!]!.push(provider.id);

  // A position is centred on its row, so rows of different widths compare.
  const position = new Map<string, number>();
  const place = (row: string[]) =>
    row.forEach((id, at) => position.set(id, at - (row.length - 1) / 2));
  rows.forEach(place);

  for (let sweep = 0; sweep < SWEEPS; sweep += 1) {
    const upward = sweep % 2 === 0;
    const order = rows.map((_, at) => (upward ? at : rows.length - 1 - at));

    for (const at of order) {
      const row = rows[at]!;
      const centre = new Map<string, number>();

      for (const id of row) {
        const refs = neighbours
          .get(id)!
          .filter((other) =>
            upward ? layer.get(other)! < at : layer.get(other)! > at,
          );
        centre.set(
          id,
          refs.length === 0
            ? position.get(id)!
            : refs.reduce((sum, other) => sum + position.get(other)!, 0) /
                refs.length,
        );
      }

      row.sort((a, b) => centre.get(a)! - centre.get(b)! || byId(a, b));
      place(row);
    }
  }

  const widest = Math.max(...rows.map((row) => row.length));
  const span = widest * NODE_WIDTH + (widest - 1) * GAP_X;
  const width = MARGIN * 2 + span + LAZY_LANE;
  const height =
    MARGIN * 2 + rows.length * NODE_HEIGHT + (rows.length - 1) * GAP_Y;

  const moduleName = new Map(
    graph.modules.map((module) => [module.id, module.name]),
  );
  const byProvider = new Map(
    providers.map((provider) => [provider.id, provider]),
  );

  const nodes: LaidNode[] = rows.flatMap((row, at) => {
    const rowSpan = row.length * NODE_WIDTH + (row.length - 1) * GAP_X;
    const left = MARGIN + (span - rowSpan) / 2;

    return row.map((id, order) => {
      const provider = byProvider.get(id)!;
      return {
        id,
        token: provider.token,
        module: provider.module,
        moduleName: moduleName.get(provider.module) ?? provider.module,
        lifetime: provider.lifetime,
        kind: provider.kind,
        async: provider.async,
        layer: at,
        order,
        x: round(left + order * (NODE_WIDTH + GAP_X)),
        y: round(MARGIN + (top - at) * (NODE_HEIGHT + GAP_Y)),
      };
    });
  });

  const at = new Map(nodes.map((node) => [node.id, node]));
  const lane = MARGIN + span + LAZY_LANE * 0.75;

  const laidEdges: LaidEdge[] = edges.map((edge) => {
    const from = at.get(edge.from)!;
    const to = at.get(edge.to)!;

    if (edge.kind === 'lazy' || edge.from === edge.to) {
      const x1 = from.x + NODE_WIDTH;
      const y1 = from.y + NODE_HEIGHT / 2;
      const x2 = to.x + NODE_WIDTH;
      const y2 = to.y + NODE_HEIGHT / 2;

      return {
        from: edge.from,
        to: edge.to,
        kind: edge.kind,
        d: `M ${round(x1)} ${round(y1)} C ${round(lane)} ${round(y1)}, ${round(lane)} ${round(y2)}, ${round(x2)} ${round(y2)}`,
        outside: true,
        mid: { x: round((x1 + 6 * lane + x2) / 8), y: round((y1 + y2) / 2) },
      };
    }

    const x1 = from.x + NODE_WIDTH / 2;
    const y1 = from.y + NODE_HEIGHT;
    const x2 = to.x + NODE_WIDTH / 2;
    const y2 = to.y;
    const bend = (y1 + y2) / 2;

    return {
      from: edge.from,
      to: edge.to,
      kind: edge.kind,
      d: `M ${round(x1)} ${round(y1)} C ${round(x1)} ${round(bend)}, ${round(x2)} ${round(bend)}, ${round(x2)} ${round(y2)}`,
      outside: false,
      mid: { x: round((x1 + x2) / 2), y: round(bend) },
    };
  });

  return { nodes, edges: laidEdges, width, height };
}
```

`apps/docs/components/graph/viewbox.ts`:

```ts
/** Pan and zoom as pure arithmetic on the SVG `viewBox` (spec §12.1). */

export interface ViewBox {
  x: number;
  y: number;
  width: number;
  height: number;
}

const ZOOM_STEP = 1.25;
const PAN_STEP = 0.1;

export function formatViewBox(box: ViewBox): string {
  return `${box.x} ${box.y} ${box.width} ${box.height}`;
}

/** `factor` above 1 zooms in. The width stays between base/8 and base*4. */
export function zoomBy(box: ViewBox, factor: number, base: ViewBox): ViewBox {
  const width = Math.min(
    base.width * 4,
    Math.max(base.width / 8, box.width / factor),
  );
  const height = width * (box.height / box.width);
  const cx = box.x + box.width / 2;
  const cy = box.y + box.height / 2;

  return { x: cx - width / 2, y: cy - height / 2, width, height };
}

export function panBy(box: ViewBox, dx: number, dy: number): ViewBox {
  return { ...box, x: box.x + dx, y: box.y + dy };
}

export function keyAction(
  key: string,
  box: ViewBox,
  base: ViewBox,
): ViewBox | null {
  switch (key) {
    case '+':
    case '=':
      return zoomBy(box, ZOOM_STEP, base);
    case '-':
      return zoomBy(box, 1 / ZOOM_STEP, base);
    case 'ArrowLeft':
      return panBy(box, -box.width * PAN_STEP, 0);
    case 'ArrowRight':
      return panBy(box, box.width * PAN_STEP, 0);
    case 'ArrowUp':
      return panBy(box, 0, -box.height * PAN_STEP);
    case 'ArrowDown':
      return panBy(box, 0, box.height * PAN_STEP);
    case '0':
      return { ...base };
    default:
      return null;
  }
}
```

`apps/docs/components/graph/GraphView.tsx`:

```tsx
import {
  layoutGraph,
  NODE_HEIGHT,
  NODE_WIDTH,
  type LaidEdge,
  type LaidNode,
} from './layout';
import type { NexusGraph } from './types';
import './graph.css';

/**
 * The provider graph as SVG (spec §12.1). No hooks, so the server renders it
 * from fixture JSON and a reader without JavaScript sees the same picture.
 *
 * Every lifetime appears as a word as well as a colour and a glyph, and the
 * `<details>` under the picture holds the same graph as two tables, which is
 * the text alternative spec §16.1 asks for.
 */

export interface GraphViewProps {
  graph: NexusGraph;
  captionId: string;
  highlight?: ReadonlySet<string>;
  dimmed?: ReadonlySet<string>;
  ready?: ReadonlySet<string>;
  modules?: ReadonlySet<string>;
  viewBox?: string;
}

type Label = 'singleton' | 'scoped' | 'transient' | 'value' | 'alias';

export function lifetimeLabel(
  node: Pick<LaidNode, 'lifetime' | 'kind'>,
): Label {
  return node.lifetime ?? (node.kind === 'alias' ? 'alias' : 'value');
}

function Glyph({ label }: { label: Label }) {
  const at = { x: NODE_WIDTH - 16, y: 16 };
  switch (label) {
    case 'singleton':
      return (
        <circle className="nexus-graph__glyph" cx={at.x} cy={at.y} r={5} />
      );
    case 'scoped':
      return (
        <path
          className="nexus-graph__glyph"
          d={`M ${at.x} ${at.y - 6} L ${at.x + 6} ${at.y} L ${at.x} ${at.y + 6} L ${at.x - 6} ${at.y} Z`}
        />
      );
    case 'transient':
      return (
        <path
          className="nexus-graph__glyph"
          d={`M ${at.x} ${at.y - 6} L ${at.x + 6} ${at.y + 5} L ${at.x - 6} ${at.y + 5} Z`}
        />
      );
    default:
      return (
        <rect
          className="nexus-graph__glyph nexus-graph__glyph--hollow"
          x={at.x - 5}
          y={at.y - 5}
          width={10}
          height={10}
        />
      );
  }
}

function Clock() {
  const cx = NODE_WIDTH - 34;
  const cy = 16;
  return (
    <g className="nexus-graph__clock" aria-hidden="true">
      <circle cx={cx} cy={cy} r={5} />
      <path d={`M ${cx} ${cy - 3} L ${cx} ${cy} L ${cx + 2.5} ${cy + 1.5}`} />
    </g>
  );
}

function stateClass(node: LaidNode, props: GraphViewProps): string {
  const classes = [
    'nexus-graph__node',
    `nexus-graph__node--${lifetimeLabel(node)}`,
  ];
  if (props.highlight?.has(node.id)) classes.push('is-lit');
  if (props.ready?.has(node.id)) classes.push('is-ready');
  if (props.dimmed?.has(node.id)) classes.push('is-dimmed');
  if (
    props.modules &&
    props.modules.size > 0 &&
    !props.modules.has(node.module)
  ) {
    classes.push('is-outside');
  }
  return classes.join(' ');
}

function EdgeStroke({
  edge,
  captionId,
  target,
  count,
}: {
  edge: LaidEdge;
  captionId: string;
  target: LaidNode;
  count: number;
}) {
  const filled = `url(#${captionId}-arrow-filled)`;
  const open = `url(#${captionId}-arrow-open)`;

  switch (edge.kind) {
    case 'lazy':
      return (
        <path
          d={edge.d}
          className="nexus-graph__stroke"
          strokeDasharray="1 4"
          markerEnd={open}
        />
      );
    case 'optional':
      return (
        <path
          d={edge.d}
          className="nexus-graph__stroke"
          strokeDasharray="6 4"
          markerEnd={filled}
        />
      );
    case 'all':
      return (
        <>
          <path
            d={edge.d}
            className="nexus-graph__stroke nexus-graph__stroke--all-outer"
          />
          <path
            d={edge.d}
            className="nexus-graph__stroke nexus-graph__stroke--all-inner"
            markerEnd={filled}
          />
          <text
            className="nexus-graph__badge"
            x={target.x + NODE_WIDTH / 2 + 8}
            y={target.y - 6}
          >
            {`×${count}`}
          </text>
        </>
      );
    case 'alias':
      return (
        <>
          <path
            d={edge.d}
            className="nexus-graph__stroke nexus-graph__stroke--thin"
            markerEnd={filled}
          />
          <text
            className="nexus-graph__alias"
            x={edge.mid.x}
            y={edge.mid.y}
            textAnchor="middle"
          >
            =
          </text>
        </>
      );
    default:
      return (
        <path d={edge.d} className="nexus-graph__stroke" markerEnd={filled} />
      );
  }
}

export default function GraphView(props: GraphViewProps) {
  const { graph, captionId } = props;
  const layout = layoutGraph(graph);
  const at = new Map(layout.nodes.map((node) => [node.id, node]));
  const allFrom = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const edge of layout.edges) {
    if (edge.kind === 'all')
      allFrom.set(edge.from, (allFrom.get(edge.from) ?? 0) + 1);
  }

  return (
    <div className="nexus-graph">
      <svg
        className="nexus-graph__svg"
        role="img"
        aria-labelledby={captionId}
        viewBox={props.viewBox ?? `0 0 ${layout.width} ${layout.height}`}
        preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"
      >
        <defs>
          <marker
            id={`${captionId}-arrow-filled`}
            viewBox="0 0 10 10"
            refX="9"
            refY="5"
            markerWidth="7"
            markerHeight="7"
            orient="auto-start-reverse"
          >
            <path d="M 0 0 L 10 5 L 0 10 z" className="nexus-graph__arrow" />
          </marker>
          <marker
            id={`${captionId}-arrow-open`}
            viewBox="0 0 10 10"
            refX="9"
            refY="5"
            markerWidth="7"
            markerHeight="7"
            orient="auto-start-reverse"
          >
            <path
              d="M 0 0 L 10 5 L 0 10"
              className="nexus-graph__arrow nexus-graph__arrow--open"
            />
          </marker>
        </defs>
        <g className="nexus-graph__edges">
          {layout.edges.map((edge, index) => (
            <g
              key={`${edge.from}-${edge.to}-${edge.kind}-${index}`}
              className={`nexus-graph__edge nexus-graph__edge--${edge.kind}`}
            >
              <EdgeStroke
                edge={edge}
                captionId={captionId}
                target={at.get(edge.to)!}
                count={allFrom.get(edge.from) ?? 0}
              />
            </g>
          ))}
        </g>
        <g className="nexus-graph__nodes">
          {layout.nodes.map((node) => (
            <g
              key={node.id}
              className={stateClass(node, props)}
              data-provider={node.id}
              data-lifetime={lifetimeLabel(node)}
              transform={`translate(${node.x} ${node.y})`}
            >
              <rect
                className="nexus-graph__box"
                width={NODE_WIDTH}
                height={NODE_HEIGHT}
              />
              <text className="nexus-graph__token" x={10} y={24}>
                {node.token}
              </text>
              <text className="nexus-graph__module" x={10} y={44}>
                {node.moduleName}
              </text>
              <text
                className="nexus-graph__lifetime"
                x={NODE_WIDTH - 10}
                y={44}
                textAnchor="end"
              >
                {lifetimeLabel(node)}
              </text>
              <Glyph label={lifetimeLabel(node)} />
              {node.kind === 'factory' && node.async === true ? (
                <Clock />
              ) : null}
            </g>
          ))}
        </g>
      </svg>
      <details className="nexus-graph__tables">
        <summary>The graph as tables</summary>
        <table>
          <caption>Providers</caption>
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th scope="col">Token</th>
              <th scope="col">Module</th>
              <th scope="col">Lifetime</th>
              <th scope="col">Kind</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {layout.nodes.map((node) => (
              <tr key={node.id}>
                <td>{node.token}</td>
                <td>{node.moduleName}</td>
                <td>{lifetimeLabel(node)}</td>
                <td>
                  {node.kind === 'factory' && node.async
                    ? 'async factory'
                    : node.kind}
                </td>
              </tr>
            ))}
          </tbody>
        </table>
        <table>
          <caption>Edges</caption>
          <thead>
            <tr>
              <th scope="col">From</th>
              <th scope="col">To</th>
              <th scope="col">Kind</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {layout.edges.map((edge, index) => (
              <tr key={`${edge.from}-${edge.to}-${index}`}>
                <td>{at.get(edge.from)!.token}</td>
                <td>{at.get(edge.to)!.token}</td>
                <td>{edge.kind}</td>
              </tr>
            ))}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </details>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```css
/* The graph view reads --meridian-* properties only (spec §8.6). The lifetime
   colour repeats the lifetime word each node carries (spec §8.2). */
.nexus-graph__svg {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: auto;
  font-family: var(--meridian-font-mono);
}

.nexus-graph__box {
  fill: var(--meridian-space-2);
  stroke: var(--meridian-rule);
  stroke-width: 1;
}

.nexus-graph__token {
  fill: var(--meridian-text);
  font-size: 13px;
}

.nexus-graph__module,
.nexus-graph__lifetime {
  fill: var(--meridian-text-secondary);
  font-size: 11px;
}

.nexus-graph__node--singleton {
  --graph-lifetime: var(--meridian-signal-cyan);
}
.nexus-graph__node--scoped {
  --graph-lifetime: var(--meridian-signal-magenta);
}
.nexus-graph__node--transient {
  --graph-lifetime: var(--meridian-signal-amber);
}
.nexus-graph__node--value,
.nexus-graph__node--alias {
  --graph-lifetime: var(--meridian-text-secondary);
}

.nexus-graph__node .nexus-graph__box {
  stroke: var(--graph-lifetime);
}
.nexus-graph__glyph {
  fill: var(--graph-lifetime);
}
.nexus-graph__glyph--hollow {
  fill: none;
  stroke: var(--graph-lifetime);
}
.nexus-graph__clock {
  fill: none;
  stroke: var(--meridian-text-secondary);
}

.nexus-graph__node.is-lit .nexus-graph__box {
  stroke-width: 2.5;
}
.nexus-graph__node.is-ready .nexus-graph__box {
  fill: var(--meridian-space-0);
}
.nexus-graph__node.is-dimmed,
.nexus-graph__node.is-outside {
  opacity: 0.35;
}

.nexus-graph__stroke {
  fill: none;
  stroke: var(--meridian-text-tertiary);
  stroke-width: 1.5;
}
.nexus-graph__stroke--thin {
  stroke-width: 1;
}
.nexus-graph__stroke--all-outer {
  stroke-width: 4.5;
}
.nexus-graph__stroke--all-inner {
  stroke: var(--meridian-space-0);
  stroke-width: 1.5;
}
.nexus-graph__arrow {
  fill: var(--meridian-text-tertiary);
}
.nexus-graph__arrow--open {
  fill: none;
  stroke: var(--meridian-text-tertiary);
}
.nexus-graph__badge,
.nexus-graph__alias {
  fill: var(--meridian-text-secondary);
  font-size: 11px;
}

.nexus-graph__node,
.nexus-graph__box {
  transition:
    opacity 200ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.3, 1),
    stroke-width 200ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.8, 0.3, 1);
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .nexus-graph__node,
  .nexus-graph__box {
    transition: none;
  }
}

.nexus-graph__tables table {
  font-size: 0.875rem;
}
```

- [ ] Step 11: Implement the controls

`apps/docs/components/graph/GraphControls.tsx`:

```tsx
'use client';

import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState, type PointerEvent } from 'react';

import GraphView, { type GraphViewProps } from './GraphView';
import { layoutGraph } from './layout';
import {
  formatViewBox,
  keyAction,
  panBy,
  zoomBy,
  type ViewBox,
} from './viewbox';

/**
 * The interactive frame around GraphView: module filter chips, and pan and
 * zoom through the SVG viewBox by drag, wheel and keys (spec §12.1).
 */
export default function GraphControls(
  props: Omit<GraphViewProps, 'viewBox' | 'modules'>,
) {
  const base = useMemo<ViewBox>(() => {
    const { width, height } = layoutGraph(props.graph);
    return { x: 0, y: 0, width, height };
  }, [props.graph]);
  const [box, setBox] = useState<ViewBox>(base);
  const [chosen, setChosen] = useState<ReadonlySet<string>>(new Set());
  const surface = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const drag = useRef<{ x: number; y: number } | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => setBox(base), [base]);

  // React registers wheel listeners as passive, so preventDefault needs a
  // listener of its own.
  useEffect(() => {
    const element = surface.current;
    if (!element) return;
    const onWheel = (event: WheelEvent) => {
      event.preventDefault();
      setBox((current) =>
        zoomBy(current, event.deltaY < 0 ? 1.1 : 1 / 1.1, base),
      );
    };
    element.addEventListener('wheel', onWheel, { passive: false });
    return () => element.removeEventListener('wheel', onWheel);
  }, [base]);

  const toggle = (id: string) =>
    setChosen((current) => {
      const next = new Set(current);
      if (next.has(id)) next.delete(id);
      else next.add(id);
      return next;
    });

  const onPointerDown = (event: PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    drag.current = { x: event.clientX, y: event.clientY };
  };
  const onPointerMove = (event: PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    const start = drag.current;
    const element = surface.current;
    if (!start || !element || element.clientWidth === 0) return;
    const scale = box.width / element.clientWidth;
    setBox((current) =>
      panBy(
        current,
        (start.x - event.clientX) * scale,
        (start.y - event.clientY) * scale,
      ),
    );
    drag.current = { x: event.clientX, y: event.clientY };
  };
  const onPointerUp = () => {
    drag.current = null;
  };

  return (
    <div className="nexus-graph-controls">
      <div
        className="nexus-graph-controls__modules"
        aria-label="Filter by module"
      >
        {props.graph.modules.map((module) => (
          <button
            key={module.id}
            type="button"
            className="nexus-graph-controls__chip"
            aria-pressed={chosen.has(module.id)}
            onClick={() => toggle(module.id)}
          >
            {module.name}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>
      <div
        ref={surface}
        role="group"
        aria-label="Graph. Pan and zoom with the arrow keys, plus, minus and 0 to reset."
        tabIndex={0}
        className="nexus-graph-controls__surface"
        onKeyDown={(event) => {
          const next = keyAction(event.key, box, base);
          if (!next) return;
          event.preventDefault();
          setBox(next);
        }}
        onPointerDown={onPointerDown}
        onPointerMove={onPointerMove}
        onPointerUp={onPointerUp}
        onPointerLeave={onPointerUp}
      >
        <GraphView {...props} modules={chosen} viewBox={formatViewBox(box)} />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

Files:

- Create: `apps/docs/components/graph/trace.ts`
- Test: `apps/docs/components/graph/trace.test.ts`

Interfaces:

- Consumes: `NexusGraph`, `TraceEvent` (`components/graph/types.ts`); the fixtures from Task 57.
- Produces:
  - `interface ReplayState { index: number; lit: Map<string, Set<string>>; ready: Set<string>; lanes: string[]; closedLanes: Set<string>; disposed: Map<string, Set<string>>; untracked: Set<string>; summary: string | null; announcement: string; unknown: boolean }` (lane keys are a scope id or `'root'`)
  - `replayTo(graph: NexusGraph | null, events: readonly TraceEvent[], index: number): ReplayState` (applies events `0..index`; `index` of `-1` is the state before any event; an index past the end clamps to the last event)
  - `describeEvent(event: TraceEvent): string`
  - `const STEP_MS = 600`
  - `const ROOT_LANE = 'root'`

```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';

import meridian from './__fixtures__/meridian.graph.json';
import events from './__fixtures__/meridian.trace.json';
import { describeEvent, replayTo, ROOT_LANE, STEP_MS } from './trace';
import type { NexusGraph, TraceEvent } from './types';

const graph = meridian as unknown as NexusGraph;
const trace = events as unknown as TraceEvent[];
const indexOf = (predicate: (event: TraceEvent) => boolean) =>
  trace.findIndex(predicate);

describe('replayTo', () => {
  it('starts with nothing lit and no announcement', () => {
    const state = replayTo(graph, trace, -1);

    expect(state.index).toBe(-1);
    expect(state.lit.get(ROOT_LANE)!.size).toBe(0);
    expect(state.announcement).toBe('');
  });

  it('reports the compile counts as the summary', () => {
    expect(replayTo(graph, trace, 0).summary).toBe(
      '4 modules, 13 providers, 0 errors',
    );
  });

  it('lights a construct in the root lane when it has no scope', () => {
    const at = indexOf(
      (event) => event.type === 'construct' && event.token === 'ReactorCore',
    );
    expect(replayTo(graph, trace, at).lit.get(ROOT_LANE)!.has('p0')).toBe(true);
  });

  it('lights a construct in the lane of its scope', () => {
    const at = indexOf(
      (event) => event.type === 'scope:create' && event.scope === 's1',
    );
    const state = replayTo(graph, trace, at);

    expect(state.lanes).toEqual(['s0', 's1']);
    expect(state.lit.get('s0')!.has('p11')).toBe(true);
    expect(state.lit.get('s1')!.has('p11')).toBe(false);
    expect(state.lit.get('s1')!.has('p10')).toBe(true);
  });

  it('marks a provider ready on init', () => {
    const at = indexOf((event) => event.type === 'init');
    expect(replayTo(graph, trace, at).ready).toEqual(new Set(['p1']));
    expect(replayTo(graph, trace, at - 1).ready.size).toBe(0);
  });

  it('closes a lane on scope:dispose', () => {
    const at = indexOf(
      (event) => event.type === 'scope:dispose' && event.scope === 's1',
    );
    const state = replayTo(graph, trace, at);

    expect(state.closedLanes).toEqual(new Set(['s1']));
    expect(state.lanes).toEqual(['s0', 's1']);
  });

  it('dims disposed instances in the order the events recorded them', () => {
    const state = replayTo(graph, trace, trace.length - 1);
    const root = [...state.disposed.get(ROOT_LANE)!];

    expect(root).toEqual(['p6', 'p9', 'p4', 'p3', 'p1', 'p8', 'p2', 'p0']);
    expect(state.lit.get(ROOT_LANE)!.has('p0')).toBe(false);
  });

  it('ends on the dispose counts', () => {
    expect(replayTo(graph, trace, trace.length - 1).summary).toBe(
      '8 instances disposed, 0 errors',
    );
  });

  it('clamps an index past the end to the last event', () => {
    expect(replayTo(graph, trace, 999).index).toBe(trace.length - 1);
  });

  it('recomputes an earlier state when stepping back', () => {
    const late = replayTo(graph, trace, trace.length - 1);
    const early = replayTo(graph, trace, 3);

    expect(early.disposed.size).toBe(0);
    expect(late.disposed.size).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(early.lit.get(ROOT_LANE)).toEqual(new Set(['p5', 'p7', 'p0']));
  });

  it('flags an untracked transient', () => {
    const extra: TraceEvent[] = [
```

`apps/docs/components/graph/trace.ts`:

```ts
import type { NexusGraph, TraceEvent } from './types';

/**
 * The trace replay as a pure function of the step (spec §12.2).
 *
 * Every call replays from the first event, so stepping back is the same call
 * with a smaller index. A Meridian trace holds about forty events, and
 * recomputing them is cheaper to reason about than an undo log.
 *
 * The replay reads the order of `dispose:instance` events from the recording
 * and computes none of it (core spec §8.2).
 */

export const STEP_MS = 600;
export const ROOT_LANE = 'root';

export interface ReplayState {
  index: number;
  lit: Map<string, Set<string>>;
  ready: Set<string>;
  lanes: string[];
  closedLanes: Set<string>;
  disposed: Map<string, Set<string>>;
  untracked: Set<string>;
  summary: string | null;
  announcement: string;
  /** Whether the event at `index` names a provider the graph does not hold. */
  unknown: boolean;
}

function plural(count: number, noun: string): string {
  return `${count} ${noun}${count === 1 ? '' : 's'}`;
}

function where(scope: string | null): string {
  return scope === null ? 'in the root' : `in scope ${scope}`;
}

export function describeEvent(event: TraceEvent): string {
  switch (event.type) {
    case 'compile':
      return `Compiled ${plural(event.modules, 'module')} and ${plural(event.providers, 'provider')} with ${plural(event.errors, 'error')}.`;
    case 'construct':
      return `${event.token} constructed ${where(event.scope)}.`;
    case 'untracked':
      return `${event.token} was built outside any scope. Nothing disposes it.`;
    case 'init':
      return `${event.token} initialised.`;
    case 'scope:create':
      return `Scope ${event.scope} opened with ${plural(event.built, 'instance')}.`;
    case 'scope:dispose':
      return `Scope ${event.scope} closed after disposing ${plural(event.disposed, 'instance')} with ${plural(event.errors, 'error')}.`;
    case 'dispose:instance':
      return `${event.token} disposed ${where(event.scope)}.`;
    case 'dispose':
      return `Container disposed ${plural(event.disposed, 'instance')} with ${plural(event.errors, 'error')}.`;
  }
}

function laneSet(map: Map<string, Set<string>>, lane: string): Set<string> {
  let set = map.get(lane);
  if (!set) {
    set = new Set();
    map.set(lane, set);
  }
  return set;
}

function providerOf(event: TraceEvent): string | null {
  return 'providerId' in event ? event.providerId : null;
}

export function replayTo(
  graph: NexusGraph | null,
  events: readonly TraceEvent[],
  index: number,
): ReplayState {
  const known = graph
    ? new Set(graph.providers.map((provider) => provider.id))
    : null;
  const holds = (id: string) => known === null || known.has(id);

  const state: ReplayState = {
    index: -1,
    lit: new Map([[ROOT_LANE, new Set<string>()]]),
    ready: new Set(),
    lanes: [],
    closedLanes: new Set(),
    disposed: new Map(),
    untracked: new Set(),
    summary: null,
    announcement: '',
    unknown: false,
  };

  const last = Math.min(index, events.length - 1);

  for (let at = 0; at <= last; at += 1) {
    const event = events[at]!;

    switch (event.type) {
      case 'compile':
        state.summary = `${plural(event.modules, 'module')}, ${plural(event.providers, 'provider')}, ${plural(event.errors, 'error')}`;
        break;
      case 'construct':
        if (holds(event.providerId))
          laneSet(state.lit, event.scope ?? ROOT_LANE).add(event.providerId);
        break;
      case 'init':
        if (holds(event.providerId)) state.ready.add(event.providerId);
        break;
      case 'untracked':
        if (holds(event.providerId)) state.untracked.add(event.providerId);
        break;
      case 'scope:create':
        if (!state.lanes.includes(event.scope)) state.lanes.push(event.scope);
        laneSet(state.lit, event.scope);
        break;
      case 'scope:dispose':
        state.closedLanes.add(event.scope);
        break;
      case 'dispose:instance': {
        const lane = event.scope ?? ROOT_LANE;
        if (holds(event.providerId)) {
          laneSet(state.disposed, lane).add(event.providerId);
          state.lit.get(lane)?.delete(event.providerId);
        }
        break;
      }
      case 'dispose':
        state.summary = `${plural(event.disposed, 'instance')} disposed, ${plural(event.errors, 'error')}`;
        break;
    }
  }

  state.index = last;

  if (last >= 0) {
    const event = events[last]!;
    const provider = providerOf(event);
    state.unknown = provider !== null && !holds(provider);
    state.announcement = state.unknown
      ? `${describeEvent(event)} This provider is not in the graph.`
      : describeEvent(event);
  }

  return state;
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from 'react';

import GraphView from './GraphView';
import { describeEvent, replayTo, ROOT_LANE, STEP_MS } from './trace';
import type { NexusGraph, TraceEvent } from './types';

/**
 * Trace replay over the graph view (spec §12.2).
 *
 * The first paint shows the final state, so the server render and a reader
 * without JavaScript see where the run ended. A fixed step replaces the
 * recorded durations: a `durationMs` measures the machine that ran the seed,
 * and the event list still shows it for a live run.
 */

const SPEEDS = [0.5, 1, 2] as const;
type Speed = (typeof SPEEDS)[number];

export interface TraceReplayProps {
  graph: NexusGraph | null;
  events: readonly TraceEvent[];
  captionId: string;
  autoplay?: boolean;
}

function union(map: Map<string, Set<string>>): Set<string> {
  return new Set([...map.values()].flatMap((set) => [...set]));
}

function duration(event: TraceEvent): string {
  return 'durationMs' in event && event.durationMs > 0
    ? ` (${event.durationMs.toFixed(1)} ms)`
    : '';
}

export default function TraceReplay({
  graph,
  events,
  captionId,
  autoplay = false,
}: TraceReplayProps) {
  const last = events.length - 1;
  const [index, setIndex] = useState(last);
  const [playing, setPlaying] = useState(false);
  const [speed, setSpeed] = useState<Speed>(1);
  const [reduced, setReduced] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const reduce =
      window.matchMedia?.('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches ?? false;
    setReduced(reduce);
    if (autoplay && !reduce) {
      setIndex(-1);
      setPlaying(true);
    }
  }, [autoplay]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!playing) return;
    if (index >= last) {
      setPlaying(false);
      return;
    }
    const timer = setTimeout(
      () => setIndex((current) => Math.min(current + 1, last)),
      STEP_MS / speed,
    );
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [playing, index, last, speed]);

  const state = useMemo(
    () => replayTo(graph, events, index),
    [graph, events, index],
  );

  const toggle = () => {
    if (playing) {
      setPlaying(false);
      return;
    }
    if (index >= last) setIndex(-1);
    setPlaying(true);
  };

  return (
    <div className="nexus-trace" data-motion={reduced ? 'reduced' : 'full'}>
      {graph ? (
        <GraphView
          graph={graph}
          captionId={captionId}
          highlight={union(state.lit)}
          dimmed={union(state.disposed)}
          ready={state.ready}
        />
      ) : null}

      <ol className="nexus-trace__lanes" aria-label="Scope lanes">
        <li>{ROOT_LANE}</li>
        {state.lanes.map((lane) => (
          <li key={lane}>
            {state.closedLanes.has(lane) ? `${lane} (closed)` : lane}
          </li>
        ))}
      </ol>

      <div
        className="nexus-trace__controls"
        role="group"
        aria-label="Trace replay controls"
      >
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setIndex((current) => Math.max(-1, current - 1))}
        >
          Previous step
        </button>
        <button type="button" onClick={toggle}>
          {playing ? 'Pause' : 'Play'}
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setIndex((current) => Math.min(last, current + 1))}
        >
          Next step
        </button>
        <input
          type="range"
          aria-label="Trace step"
          min={-1}
          max={last}
          step={1}
          value={index}
          onChange={(event) => setIndex(Number(event.currentTarget.value))}
        />
        {SPEEDS.map((each) => (
          <button
            key={each}
            type="button"
            aria-pressed={speed === each}
            onClick={() => setSpeed(each)}
          >
            {`${each}×`}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>

      <p className="nexus-trace__announce" aria-live="polite">
        {state.announcement}
      </p>
      {state.summary ? (
        <p className="nexus-trace__summary">{state.summary}</p>
      ) : null}

      <ol className="nexus-trace__events">
        {events.map((event, at) => (
          <li key={at} aria-current={at === index ? 'step' : undefined}>
            {describeEvent(event)}
            {duration(event)}
          </li>
        ))}
      </ol>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```ts
import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';
```

```ts
import type { SerializedError } from '../runtime/protocol';

/**
 * What the error view shows for a failed `create` or `load` (spec §12.3).
 *
 * A ProviderError that wraps a cause shows the cause first, because an invalid
 * module option arrives as NEXUS_PROVIDER_FAILED and the reader needs the
 * schema's code and issues. The outer code stays beneath it.
 */

export function errorEntries(error: SerializedError): {
  primary: SerializedError;
  outer: SerializedError | null;
  entries: SerializedError[];
} {
  const outer =
    error.code === 'NEXUS_PROVIDER_FAILED' && error.cause ? error : null;
  const primary = outer ? outer.cause! : error;
  const entries =
    primary.code === 'NEXUS_BLUEPRINT_INVALID' &&
    primary.errors &&
    primary.errors.length > 0
      ? primary.errors
      : [primary];

  return { primary, outer, entries };
}

/** Points on a circle, first at the top, clockwise. The repeated closing name is dropped. */
export function ringPoints(
  path: string[],
  radius: number,
): { name: string; x: number; y: number }[] {
  const names =
    path.length > 1 && path[0] === path[path.length - 1]
      ? path.slice(0, -1)
      : path;
  const round = (value: number) => Math.round(value * 10) / 10 + 0;

  return names.map((name, at) => {
    const angle = -Math.PI / 2 + (2 * Math.PI * at) / names.length;
    return {
      name,
      x: round(radius + radius * Math.cos(angle)),
      y: round(radius + radius * Math.sin(angle)),
    };
  });
}

export function anchorFor(code: string): string {
  return `/api-errors/#${code.toLowerCase()}`;
}

export function messageBody(message: string): string {
  return message.replace(/^\[NEXUS_[A-Z_]+\]\s*/, '');
}
```

`apps/docs/components/graph/ErrorView.tsx`:

```tsx
import Link from 'next/link';

import type { SerializedError } from '../runtime/protocol';
import { anchorFor, errorEntries, messageBody, ringPoints } from './error-view';
import './graph.css';

/**
 * The console's view of a failed `create` or `load` (spec §12.3). No hooks, so
 * the server renders it from a fixture. Links go through next/link, which adds
 * the base path on the `/next/` build.
 */

function Code({ entry }: { entry: SerializedError }) {
  return entry.code ? (
    <Link href={anchorFor(entry.code)}>
      <code>{entry.code}</code>
    </Link>
  ) : (
    <code>{entry.name}</code>
  );
}

function Ring({ label, path }: { label: string; path: string[] }) {
  const radius = 60 + 10 * path.length;
  const pad = 70;
  const points = ringPoints(path, radius).map((point) => ({
    ...point,
    x: point.x + pad,
    y: point.y + pad,
  }));
  const closed = [...points, points[0]!];
  const d = closed
    .map((point, at) => `${at === 0 ? 'M' : 'L'} ${point.x} ${point.y}`)
    .join(' ');
  const names = [...points.map((point) => point.name), points[0]!.name].join(
    ' → ',
  );
  const size = 2 * (radius + pad);

  return (
    <svg
      className="nexus-errors__ring"
      role="img"
      aria-label={`${label}: ${names}`}
      viewBox={`0 0 ${size} ${size}`}
    >
      <path d={d} className="nexus-errors__ring-path" />
      {points.map((point) => (
        <g key={point.name}>
          <circle
            cx={point.x}
            cy={point.y}
            r={5}
            className="nexus-errors__ring-node"
          />
          <text
            x={point.x}
            y={point.y - 12}
            textAnchor="middle"
            className="nexus-errors__ring-name"
          >
            {point.name}
          </text>
        </g>
      ))}
    </svg>
  );
}

export default function ErrorView({
  error,
  captionId,
}: {
  error: SerializedError;
  captionId?: string;
}) {
  const { outer, entries } = errorEntries(error);

  return (
    <section className="nexus-errors" aria-labelledby={captionId}>
      <ol className="nexus-errors__list">
        {entries.map((entry, at) => (
          <li key={at} className="nexus-errors__entry">
            <p className="nexus-errors__code">
              <Code entry={entry} />
            </p>
            <p className="nexus-errors__message">
              {messageBody(entry.message)}
            </p>
            {entry.issues && entry.issues.length > 0 ? (
              <ul className="nexus-errors__issues">
                {entry.issues.map((issue, index) => (
                  <li key={index}>
                    {issue.path && issue.path.length > 0
                      ? `${issue.path.join('.')}: ${issue.message}`
                      : issue.message}
                  </li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            ) : null}
            {entry.path && entry.path.length > 1 ? (
              <Ring label={entry.code ?? entry.name} path={entry.path} />
            ) : null}
          </li>
        ))}
      </ol>
      {outer ? (
        <p className="nexus-errors__outer">
          The container raised it as <Code entry={outer} />.{' '}
          {messageBody(outer.message)}
        </p>
      ) : null}
    </section>
  );
}
```

The issues list sits inside a list item, so `getAllByRole('listitem')` in the first test counts only the outer entries for an error with no issues, which is the blueprint fixture.

- [ ] Step 3: Implement section tracking

`apps/docs/components/console/section-tracking.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * Which H2 section the console follows (spec §10.2): the last heading whose
 * top has reached the offset below the navbar. Above the first heading the
 * answer is null, and the panel shows the first section's view.
 */

export interface SectionRect {
  id: string;
  top: number;
}

export function nearestSection(
  rects: readonly SectionRect[],
  offset: number,
): string | null {
  let chosen: string | null = null;

  for (const rect of [...rects].sort((a, b) => a.top - b.top)) {
    if (rect.top - offset > 1) break;
    chosen = rect.id;
  }

  return chosen;
}

/** The last heading before `element`, with `headings` in document order. */
export function sectionOf(
  element: Element,
  headings: readonly Element[],
): Element | null {
  let found: Element | null = null;

  for (const heading of headings) {
    if (
      !(
        heading.compareDocumentPosition(element) &
        Node.DOCUMENT_POSITION_FOLLOWING
      )
    )
      break;
    found = heading;
  }

  return found;
}
```

`apps/docs/components/console/live.ts`:

```ts
import type { RunnerMessage } from '../runtime/protocol';
import type { ConsoleFixture } from './fixture';

/**
 * A run's messages in the shape the build-time fixture has, so one function
 * builds the console's items for a static view and for a live run.
 */
export function fixtureFromMessages(
  seed: string,
  messages: readonly RunnerMessage[],
): ConsoleFixture {
  const fixture: ConsoleFixture = {
    seed,
    graph: null,
    trace: [],
    console: [],
    error: null,
  };

  for (const message of messages) {
    switch (message.type) {
      case 'graph':
        fixture.graph = message.graph;
        break;
      case 'trace':
        fixture.trace.push(message.event);
        break;
      case 'console':
        fixture.console.push({ level: message.level, args: message.args });
        break;
      case 'error':
        fixture.error ??= {
          name: message.name,
          message: message.message,
          code: message.code,
          stack: message.stack,
          errors: message.errors,
          cause: message.cause,
        };
        break;
      default:
        break;
    }
  }

  return fixture;
}
```

`apps/docs/components/console/transition.ts`:

```ts
import { startTransition } from 'react';

/**
 * Applies a console view change inside `startTransition`. The panel wraps its
 * items in React 19.3's `<ViewTransition>`, and a transition update is what
 * makes React call `document.startViewTransition` (spec §10.5). A browser
 * without the API gets the update with no animation, and global.css and
 * console.css turn the animation off under reduced motion.
 *
 * If Task 5 (E2) failed, this body is the recorded fallback:
 * `document.startViewTransition?.(() => flushSync(update)) ?? update()`.
 */
export function applyViewChange(update: () => void): void {
  startTransition(update);
}
```
