`apps/docs/components/console/widgets.tsx`:

```tsx
import { createWidgets, type WidgetItemComponent } from '@evanion/react-widget';
import type { ReactNode } from 'react';

import ErrorView from '../graph/ErrorView';
import GraphView from '../graph/GraphView';
import TraceReplay from '../graph/TraceReplay';
import type { NexusGraph, TraceEvent } from '../graph/types';
import type { SerializedError } from '../runtime/protocol';
import { renderValue } from '../runtime/serialize';
import type { ConsoleFixture } from './fixture';

/**
 * The console's panels as widget items (spec §10.4). `createWidgets` runs once,
 * at module scope. The item chrome places a panel from `meta.area`, and
 * `suspense: 'none'` keeps every panel inline: a streamed boundary on a static
 * export outlines content into a hidden div that Pagefind indexes out of order.
 *
 * The server builds items from the fixture JSON; after Run the panel builds
 * them from the run's messages through the same `consoleItems`.
 */

export interface ConsoleMeta {
  area: 'main' | 'side' | 'strip';
  tab?: string;
}

export type ConsoleViewKind = 'graph' | 'trace' | 'specimen';

type Entries = ConsoleFixture['console'];

function GraphPanel({
  graph,
  captionId,
}: {
  graph: NexusGraph;
  captionId: string;
}) {
  return <GraphView graph={graph} captionId={captionId} />;
}

function TracePanel({
  graph,
  events,
  captionId,
}: {
  graph: NexusGraph | null;
  events: TraceEvent[];
  captionId: string;
}) {
  return <TraceReplay graph={graph} events={events} captionId={captionId} />;
}

function line(entry: Entries[number]): string {
  return entry.args.map(renderValue).join(' ');
}

/** Phase 1's specimen is the run's last line of output. Phase 2 adds per-page specimens here. */
function SpecimenPanel({ entries }: { entries: Entries }) {
  const last = entries.at(-1);
  return (
    <output className="nexus-console-specimen">
      {last ? line(last) : 'The run printed nothing.'}
    </output>
  );
}

function LogPanel({ entries }: { entries: Entries }) {
  if (entries.length === 0)
    return <p className="nexus-console-log__empty">The run printed nothing.</p>;
  return (
    <ol className="nexus-console-log">
      {entries.map((entry, at) => (
        <li key={at} data-level={entry.level}>
          <span className="nexus-console-log__level">{entry.level}</span>{' '}
          <code>{line(entry)}</code>
        </li>
      ))}
    </ol>
  );
}

function ErrorsPanel({
  error,
  captionId,
}: {
  error: SerializedError;
  captionId: string;
}) {
  return <ErrorView error={error} captionId={captionId} />;
}

function JsonPanel({ label, value }: { label: string; value: string }) {
  return (
    <figure className="nexus-console-json">
      <figcaption>{label}</figcaption>
      <pre>
        <code>{value}</code>
      </pre>
    </figure>
  );
}

const ConsoleItem: WidgetItemComponent<ConsoleMeta> = ({
  children,
  meta,
  ...rest
}) => (
  <div
    {...rest}
    className={`nexus-console-item nexus-console-item--${meta?.area ?? 'main'}`}
    data-tab={meta?.tab}
  >
    {children}
  </div>
);

function ConsoleStage({ children }: { children?: ReactNode }) {
  return <div className="nexus-console-stage">{children}</div>;
}

export const { Widgets: ConsoleWidgets, defineItems: defineConsoleItems } =
  createWidgets({
    components: {
      graph: GraphPanel,
      trace: TracePanel,
      specimen: SpecimenPanel,
      log: LogPanel,
      errors: ErrorsPanel,
      json: JsonPanel,
    },
    chrome: { item: ConsoleItem, wrapper: ConsoleStage, suspense: 'none' },
  });

export type ConsoleItems = Parameters<typeof ConsoleWidgets>[0]['items'];

export function supportedViews(fixture: ConsoleFixture): ConsoleViewKind[] {
  const views: ConsoleViewKind[] = [];
  if (fixture.graph) views.push('graph');
  if (fixture.trace.length > 0) views.push('trace');
  views.push('specimen');
  return views;
}

export function consoleItems(
  fixture: ConsoleFixture,
  view: ConsoleViewKind,
  captionId: string,
): ConsoleItems {
  const log = {
    id: 'log',
    type: 'log' as const,
    props: { entries: fixture.console },
    meta: { area: 'strip' as const },
  };

  if (fixture.error) {
    return defineConsoleItems([
      {
        id: 'errors',
        type: 'errors',
        props: { error: fixture.error, captionId },
        meta: { area: 'main' },
      },
      log,
    ]);
  }

  if (view === 'graph' && fixture.graph) {
    return defineConsoleItems([
      {
        id: 'graph',
        type: 'graph',
        props: { graph: fixture.graph, captionId },
        meta: { area: 'main' },
      },
      {
        id: 'json',
        type: 'json',
        props: {
          label: 'graph()',
          value: JSON.stringify(fixture.graph, null, 2),
        },
        meta: { area: 'side', tab: 'graph()' },
      },
      log,
    ]);
  }

  if (view === 'trace' && fixture.trace.length > 0) {
    return defineConsoleItems([
      {
        id: 'trace',
        type: 'trace',
        props: { graph: fixture.graph, events: fixture.trace, captionId },
        meta: { area: 'main' },
      },
      log,
    ]);
  }

  return defineConsoleItems([
    {
      id: 'specimen',
      type: 'specimen',
      props: { entries: fixture.console },
      meta: { area: 'main' },
    },
    log,
  ]);
}
```

```tsx
import { existsSync, readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join } from 'node:path';

import type { ConsoleFixture } from './fixture';
import { consoleItems, ConsoleWidgets, type ConsoleViewKind } from './widgets';
import './console.css';

/**
 * One console view in an H2 section of a concept page (spec §10.1).
 *
 * The server renders the view from the fixture `console-fixtures.mjs` wrote, so
 * the HTML carries the SVG and the caption and a reader without JavaScript
 * loses nothing. Below 1,280 px this figure is what the reader sees. At 1,280
 * px and wider the sticky panel reads the embedded JSON and console.css hides
 * the figure, but only once the panel has marked `html[data-console-ready]`.
 */

export const FIXTURE_DIR = join(
  process.cwd(),
  'components',
  'console',
  'fixtures',
);

export function loadConsoleFixture(
  seed: string,
  dir: string = FIXTURE_DIR,
): ConsoleFixture {
  const path = join(dir, `${seed}.json`);
  if (!existsSync(path)) {
    throw new Error(
      `ConsoleView names the seed '${seed}', and ${path} does not exist. ` +
        'Run `npx nx run @nexusdi/docs:console-fixtures` and build again.',
    );
  }
  return JSON.parse(readFileSync(path, 'utf8')) as ConsoleFixture;
}

export function captionIdFor(seed: string, view: string): string {
  return `console-${seed.replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/gi, '-')}-${view}-caption`;
}

function embed(fixture: ConsoleFixture): string {
  return JSON.stringify(fixture).replace(/</g, '\\u003c');
}

export interface ConsoleViewProps {
  seed: string;
  view: ConsoleViewKind;
  caption: string;
  /** Tests only: the directory the fixture is read from. */
  fixtures?: string;
}

export default function ConsoleView({
  seed,
  view,
  caption,
  fixtures,
}: ConsoleViewProps) {
  if (caption.trim() === '') {
    throw new Error(
      `ConsoleView '${seed}' has an empty caption. The caption states in words what the view shows.`,
    );
  }

  const fixture = loadConsoleFixture(seed, fixtures);
  const captionId = captionIdFor(seed, view);

  return (
    <figure
      className="nexus-console-view"
      data-console-view=""
      data-seed={seed}
      data-view={view}
    >
      <ConsoleWidgets items={consoleItems(fixture, view, captionId)} />
      <figcaption id={captionId}>{caption}</figcaption>
      <script
        type="application/json"
        dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: embed(fixture) }}
      />
    </figure>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import './console.css';

/**
 * Marks an H2 section of a concept page with nothing for the console to show
 * (amendment A1). The reason renders inline, and the panel shows it when the
 * section is in view.
 */
export default function ConsoleExempt({ reason }: { reason: string }) {
  if (reason.trim() === '') {
    throw new Error(
      'ConsoleExempt needs a non-empty reason. The console panel shows it to the reader.',
    );

  return (
    <p
      className="nexus-console-exempt"
```

- [ ] Step 18: Implement `runSeed`

```ts
// apps/docs/components/runtime/run-seed.ts
import { toRunModules, type SeedBundle } from '../playground/run';
import { basePath } from './base-path';
import type { RuntimeManifest } from './manifest';
import type { RunnerMessage } from './protocol';
import { createRunController, type RunOutcome } from './run-controller';
import { buildSrcdoc } from './srcdoc';

export interface RunSeedDeps {
  fetchJson?: <T>(path: string) => Promise<T>;
  host?: HTMLElement;
  origin?: string;
}

async function fetchRuntimeJson<T>(path: string): Promise<T> {
  const response = await fetch(`${basePath}/runtime/${path}`);
  if (!response.ok)
    throw new Error(`${path} answered HTTP ${response.status}.`);
  return (await response.json()) as T;
}

/**
 * Runs one seed's emitted modules in a fresh sandboxed frame and reports every
 * accepted message. The console panel imports this on Run, so no runtime code
 * loads before the reader asks for it (spec §10.6).
 */
export async function runSeed(
  seedId: string,
  onMessage: (message: RunnerMessage) => void,
  deps: RunSeedDeps = {},
): Promise<RunOutcome> {
  const fetchJson = deps.fetchJson ?? fetchRuntimeJson;
  const [manifest, index] = await Promise.all([
    fetchJson<RuntimeManifest>('manifest.json'),
    fetchJson<Record<string, string>>('seeds/index.json'),
  ]);
  const file = index[seedId];
  if (!file) throw new Error(`No seed named ${seedId} exists.`);
  const bundle = await fetchJson<SeedBundle>(file);

  const host =
    deps.host ?? document.body.appendChild(document.createElement('div'));
  if (!deps.host) host.hidden = true;
  const controller = createRunController(host);

  try {
    const handle = controller.run({
      document: (runId) =>
        buildSrcdoc({
          origin: deps.origin ?? location.origin,
          basePath,
          manifest,
          runId,
          modules: toRunModules(bundle.modules),
        }),
    });
    handle.onMessage(onMessage);
    return await handle.done;
  } finally {
    controller.dispose();
    if (!deps.host) host.remove();
  }
}
```

```tsx
}));

class FakeObserver {
  static last: FakeObserver;
  constructor(readonly callback: () => void) {
    FakeObserver.last = this;
  }
  observe() {}
  unobserve() {}
  disconnect() {}
  takeRecords() {
    return [];
  }
}

function wide(matches: boolean) {
  window.matchMedia = vi.fn().mockImplementation((query: string) => ({
    matches: matches && query.includes('min-width'),
    media: query,
    onchange: null,
    addEventListener: vi.fn(),
    removeEventListener: vi.fn(),
    addListener: vi.fn(),
    removeListener: vi.fn(),
    dispatchEvent: vi.fn(),
  }));
}

function figure(
  seed: string,
  view: string,
  caption: string,
  fixture: unknown,
): string {
  return (
    `<figure data-console-view="" data-seed="${seed}" data-view="${view}">` +
    `<figcaption>${caption}</figcaption>` +
    `<script type="application/json">${JSON.stringify(fixture)}</script></figure>`
  );
}

function top(id: string, value: number) {
  document.getElementById(id)!.getBoundingClientRect = () =>
    ({ top: value }) as DOMRect;
}

function panel(): HTMLElement {
  return document.querySelector('[data-console-panel]') as HTMLElement;
}

beforeEach(() => {
  vi.stubGlobal('IntersectionObserver', FakeObserver);
  wide(true);
  document.body.innerHTML =
    '<article>' +
    '<h2 id="alpha">Alpha</h2>' +
    figure('test/alpha', 'graph', 'ShipComputer takes ReactorCore.', alpha) +
    '<h2 id="beta">Beta</h2>' +
    figure('test/beta', 'specimen', 'The ship reports online.', beta) +
    '<h2 id="gamma">Gamma</h2>' +
    '<p data-console-exempt="" data-reason="This section configures TypeScript.">This section configures TypeScript.</p>' +
    '</article>';
  top('alpha', 200);
  top('beta', 900);
  top('gamma', 1600);
});

afterEach(() => {
  vi.unstubAllGlobals();
  delete document.documentElement.dataset.consoleReady;
});

describe('ConsolePanel', () => {
  it('marks the document ready and shows the first section above the first heading', () => {
    render(<ConsolePanel runner={vi.fn()} />);

    expect(document.documentElement.dataset.consoleReady).toBe('');

    ).toBeTruthy();
    expect(panel().getAttribute('data-island')).toBe(CONSOLE_ISLAND);
    expect(panel().hasAttribute('data-pagefind-ignore')).toBe(true);
  });

  it('follows the section in view', () => {
    render(<ConsolePanel runner={vi.fn()} />);
    top('alpha', -400);
    top('beta', 50);
    act(() => FakeObserver.last.callback());

    expect(within(panel()).getByText('Beta')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(
      within(panel()).getAllByText(/Meridian online/).length,
    ).toBeGreaterThan(0);
  });

  it('shows the reason of an exempt section', () => {
    render(<ConsolePanel runner={vi.fn()} />);
    top('alpha', -1400);
    top('beta', -700);
    top('gamma', 20);
    act(() => FakeObserver.last.callback());

    expect(
      within(panel()).getByText('This section configures TypeScript.'),
    ).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('offers a tab per view the seed supports and switches on click', () => {
    render(<ConsolePanel runner={vi.fn()} />);
    const tabs = within(panel()).getAllByRole('tab');

    expect(tabs.map((tab) => tab.textContent)).toEqual([
      'Graph',

  it('links the seed to the Playground', () => {

        .getByRole('link', { name: 'Edit this in the Playground' })

  it('replaces the static view with the run result after Run', async () => {
```

```tsx
'use client';

import Link from 'next/link';
import { useEffect, useId, useState, ViewTransition } from 'react';

import { ConsoleFrame } from '@nexusdi/meridian-ui';

import type { RunnerMessage } from '../runtime/protocol';
import type { ConsoleFixture } from './fixture';
import { fixtureFromMessages } from './live';
import { nearestSection, sectionOf } from './section-tracking';
import { applyViewChange } from './transition';
import {
  consoleItems,
  ConsoleWidgets,
  supportedViews,
  type ConsoleViewKind,
} from './widgets';
import './console.css';

/**
 * The sticky ship console of a concept page (spec §10.2), and the page's one
 * client island (35 kB budget, spec §16.2). Task 13's budget checker finds its
 * chunk by CONSOLE_ISLAND.
 *
 * It reads what the server already rendered: each ConsoleView's embedded
 * fixture and each ConsoleExempt's reason, matched to the H2 above it. It
 * follows the section nearest the top of the viewport, and never moves focus.
 */

export const CONSOLE_ISLAND = 'nexus-console-island';
export const WIDE_QUERY = '(min-width: 1280px)';
export const NAVBAR_OFFSET = 96;

export type SeedRunner = (
  seedId: string,
  onMessage: (message: RunnerMessage) => void,
) => Promise<unknown>;

const defaultRunner: SeedRunner = async (seedId, onMessage) => {
  const { runSeed } = await import('../runtime/run-seed');
  return runSeed(seedId, onMessage);
};

const LABELS: Record<ConsoleViewKind, string> = {
  graph: 'Graph',
  trace: 'Trace',
  specimen: 'Output',
};

type SectionView =
  | {
      kind: 'view';
      sectionId: string;
      heading: string;
      seed: string;
      view: ConsoleViewKind;
      caption: string;
      fixture: ConsoleFixture;
    }
  | { kind: 'exempt'; sectionId: string; heading: string; reason: string };

function readViews(): SectionView[] {
  const headings = [...document.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('h2[id]')];

  return [
    ...document.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(
      'figure[data-console-view], [data-console-exempt]',
    ),
  ].flatMap((element): SectionView[] => {
    const heading = sectionOf(element, headings);
    const sectionId = heading?.id ?? '';
    const headingText = heading?.textContent?.trim() ?? '';

    if (element.hasAttribute('data-console-exempt')) {
      return [
        {
          kind: 'exempt',
          sectionId,
          heading: headingText,
          reason: element.dataset.reason ?? '',
        },
      ];
    }

    const data = element.querySelector(
      'script[type="application/json"]',
    )?.textContent;
    if (!data) return [];

    return [
      {
        kind: 'view',
        sectionId,
        heading: headingText,
        seed: element.dataset.seed ?? '',
        view: (element.dataset.view as ConsoleViewKind) ?? 'graph',
        caption: element.querySelector('figcaption')?.textContent?.trim() ?? '',
        fixture: JSON.parse(data) as ConsoleFixture,
      },
    ];
  });
}

export default function ConsolePanel({
  runner = defaultRunner,
}: {
  runner?: SeedRunner;
}) {
  const captionId = useId();
  const [views, setViews] = useState<SectionView[]>([]);
  const [active, setActive] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<ConsoleViewKind | null>(null);
  const [live, setLive] = useState<Record<string, ConsoleFixture>>({});
  const [running, setRunning] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!window.matchMedia(WIDE_QUERY).matches) return;

    document.documentElement.dataset.consoleReady = '';
    setViews(readViews());

    const headings = [...document.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('h2[id]')];
    const update = () => {
      const next = nearestSection(
        headings.map((heading) => ({
          id: heading.id,
          top: heading.getBoundingClientRect().top,
        })),
        NAVBAR_OFFSET,
      );
      applyViewChange(() => setActive(next));
    };

    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(update, {
      rootMargin: '0px 0px -50% 0px',
      threshold: [0, 1],
    });
    for (const heading of headings) observer.observe(heading);
    update();

    return () => {
      observer.disconnect();
      delete document.documentElement.dataset.consoleReady;
    };
  }, []);

  // A new section opens on the view its author chose.
  useEffect(() => setTab(null), [active]);

  const current =
    views.find((view) => view.sectionId === active) ?? views[0] ?? null;

  if (!current) {
    return (
      <div
        className="nexus-console-panel"
        data-console-panel=""
        data-island={CONSOLE_ISLAND}
        data-pagefind-ignore=""
      />
    );
  }

  if (current.kind === 'exempt') {
    return (
      <div
        className="nexus-console-panel"
        data-console-panel=""
        data-island={CONSOLE_ISLAND}
        data-pagefind-ignore=""
      >
        <ConsoleFrame title={current.heading || 'Ship console'}>
          <p className="nexus-console-panel__caption">{current.reason}</p>
        </ConsoleFrame>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const fixture = live[current.seed] ?? current.fixture;
  const kinds = supportedViews(fixture);
  const kind = tab && kinds.includes(tab) ? tab : current.view;
  const seed = current.seed;

  const run = async () => {
    setRunning(true);
    const messages: RunnerMessage[] = [];
    try {
      await runner(seed, (message) => messages.push(message));
    } finally {
      const result = fixtureFromMessages(seed, messages);
      applyViewChange(() =>
        setLive((previous) => ({ ...previous, [seed]: result })),
      );
      setRunning(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div
      className="nexus-console-panel"
      data-console-panel=""
      data-island={CONSOLE_ISLAND}
      data-pagefind-ignore=""
    >
      <ConsoleFrame
        title={current.heading || 'Ship console'}
        tabs={
          <div role="tablist" aria-label="Console views">
            {kinds.map((each) => (
              <button
                key={each}
                type="button"
                role="tab"
                aria-selected={each === kind}
                onClick={() => applyViewChange(() => setTab(each))}
              >
                {LABELS[each]}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        }
        actions={
          <>
            <button type="button" onClick={run} disabled={running}>
              {running ? 'Running' : 'Run'}
            </button>
            <Link href={`/playground/?seed=${encodeURIComponent(seed)}`}>
              Edit this in the Playground
            </Link>
          </>
        }
      >
        <p id={captionId} className="nexus-console-panel__caption">
          {current.caption}
        </p>
        <ViewTransition>
          <ConsoleWidgets items={consoleItems(fixture, kind, captionId)} />
        </ViewTransition>
      </ConsoleFrame>
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Group I: The progress store

Group I builds the Academy's IndexedDB store with schema version 1, its additive upgrade rule, the derived figures, export, reset, the persistence request and the in-memory fallback, plus a progress route that proves the storage behaviour end to end. Mission content, the mission layouts, the mission cards and the next-mission recommendation are Phase 2, because each one needs missions.

The browser tests run in the Vitest browser project on Chromium that experiment E6 (Task 9) set up for `*.browser.test.ts`. They use a fresh database name per test, so no test reads another test's records.

```ts
// apps/docs/components/academy/store.browser.test.ts
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';

import type { AttemptRecord, MissionRecord } from './records';
import {
  openDatabase,
  openProgress,
  openProgressOrMemory,
  SCHEMA_STEPS,
  type SchemaStep,
} from './store';

const names: string[] = [];

function freshName(): string {
  const name = `test-${crypto.randomUUID()}`;
  names.push(name);
  return name;
}

function deleteDatabase(name: string): Promise<void> {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    const request = indexedDB.deleteDatabase(name);
    request.onsuccess = () => resolve();
    request.onerror = () => resolve();
    request.onblocked = () => resolve();
  });
}

afterEach(async () => {
  await Promise.all(names.splice(0).map(deleteDatabase));
});

function put(
  db: IDBDatabase,
  store: string,
  records: unknown[],
): Promise<void> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const tx = db.transaction(store, 'readwrite');
    for (const record of records) tx.objectStore(store).put(record);
    tx.oncomplete = () => resolve();
    tx.onerror = () => reject(tx.error);
  });
}

// A later schema adds an index and rewrites nothing, which is the one rule
// every upgrade step follows.
const addOutcomeIndex: SchemaStep = (_db, tx) => {
  tx.objectStore('attempts').createIndex('outcome', 'outcome');
};
const versionTwo = { ...SCHEMA_STEPS, 2: addOutcomeIndex };

const mission: MissionRecord = {
  missionId: '06-shuttle-launch',
  firstOpenedAt: 1_000,
  lastCode: { 'main.ts': 'export const ship = 1;' },
  lastCodeHash: 'abc',
};

const attempt: AttemptRecord = {
  attemptId: 'a1',
  missionId: '06-shuttle-launch',
  missionVersion: 1,
  codeHash: 'abc',
  startedAt: 2_000,
  durationMs: 500,
  outcome: 'fail',
};

describe('openDatabase', () => {
  it('creates the five stores and their indexes at version 1', async () => {
    const db = await openDatabase({ name: freshName() });

    expect([...db.objectStoreNames].sort()).toEqual([
      'attempts',
      'hintEvents',
      'meta',
      'missions',
      'objectiveResults',
    ]);

    const tx = db.transaction(
      ['attempts', 'objectiveResults', 'hintEvents'],
      'readonly',
    );
    expect([...tx.objectStore('attempts').indexNames].sort()).toEqual([
      'missionId',
      'missionVersion',
    ]);
    expect(tx.objectStore('attempts').index('missionVersion').keyPath).toEqual([
      'missionId',
      'missionVersion',
    ]);
    expect(tx.objectStore('objectiveResults').keyPath).toEqual([
      'attemptId',
      'objectiveId',
    ]);
    expect(
      tx.objectStore('objectiveResults').index('objective').keyPath,
    ).toEqual(['missionId', 'missionVersion', 'objectiveId']);
    expect(tx.objectStore('hintEvents').autoIncrement).toBe(true);
    db.close();
  });

  it('writes the schema record into meta', async () => {
    const store = await openProgress({ name: freshName() });
    const { meta } = await store.readAll();

    expect(meta).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(meta[0]).toMatchObject({ key: 'schema', version: 1 });
    expect(typeof meta[0]?.createdAt).toBe('number');
    store.close();
  });

  it('reads every version 1 record back unchanged after a version 2 upgrade', async () => {
    const name = freshName();
    const first = await openDatabase({ name });
    await put(first, 'missions', [mission]);
    await put(first, 'attempts', [attempt]);
    const before = await (await openProgress({ name })).readAll();
    first.close();

    const upgraded = await openProgress({
      name,
      version: 2,
      steps: versionTwo,
    });
    const after = await upgraded.readAll();

    expect(after.missions).toEqual(before.missions);
    expect(after.attempts).toEqual(before.attempts);
    expect(after.meta[0]).toEqual({ ...before.meta[0], version: 2 });
    upgraded.close();
  });

  it('closes an open connection when another tab upgrades', async () => {
    const name = freshName();
    const older = await openDatabase({ name });

    const newer = await openDatabase({ name, version: 2, steps: versionTwo });

    expect(() => older.transaction('meta')).toThrow(/closing|closed/i);
    newer.close();
  });

  it('calls onBlocked while a connection that ignores versionchange stays open', async () => {
    const name = freshName();
    const stubborn = await new Promise<IDBDatabase>((resolve) => {
      const request = indexedDB.open(name, 1);
      request.onupgradeneeded = () =>
        SCHEMA_STEPS[1]?.(request.result, request.transaction!);
      request.onsuccess = () => resolve(request.result);
    });
    let blocked = false;

    const pending = openDatabase({
      name,
      version: 2,
      steps: versionTwo,
      onBlocked: () => {
        blocked = true;
        stubborn.close();
      },
    });

    const db = await pending;
    expect(blocked).toBe(true);
    db.close();
  });
});

describe('openProgressOrMemory', () => {
  it('falls back to memory when another tab holds a newer schema', async () => {
    // Review Focus 2: a newer tab upgraded the database, and this build asks
    // for version 1.
    const name = freshName();
    await new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
      const request = indexedDB.open(name, 2);
      request.onsuccess = () => {
        request.result.close();
        resolve();
      };
    });

    const opened = await openProgressOrMemory({ name });

    expect(opened.persistent).toBe(false);
    expect(opened.reason).toBe('VersionError');
    await expect(opened.store.readAll()).resolves.toEqual({
      meta: [],
      missions: [],
      attempts: [],
      objectiveResults: [],
      hintEvents: [],
    });
  });

  it('falls back to memory when indexedDB.open throws', async () => {
    const original = IDBFactory.prototype.open;
    IDBFactory.prototype.open = () => {
      throw new DOMException('denied', 'SecurityError');
    };
    try {
      const opened = await openProgressOrMemory({ name: freshName() });
      expect(opened).toMatchObject({
        persistent: false,
        reason: 'SecurityError',
      });
    } finally {
      IDBFactory.prototype.open = original;
    }
  });

  it('reports a persistent store when IndexedDB opens', async () => {
    const opened = await openProgressOrMemory({ name: freshName() });

    expect(opened).toMatchObject({ persistent: true, reason: null });
    opened.store.close();
  });
});
```

```ts
// apps/docs/components/academy/records.ts
/**
 * The records the Academy stores, one interface per IndexedDB store.
 *
 * Every store holds raw events or the reader's own code. Every figure the
 * Academy shows is derived from these when it renders (spec §13.6), so a new
 * figure needs no stored field and no data migration.
 */

export interface MetaRecord {
  key: 'schema';
  version: number;
  createdAt: number;
}

export interface MissionRecord {
  missionId: string;
  firstOpenedAt: number;
  lastCode: Record<string, string>;
  lastCodeHash: string;
  passedCode?: Record<string, string>;
  passedVersion?: number;
}

export type AttemptOutcome = 'pass' | 'fail' | 'error' | 'timeout';

export interface AttemptRecord {
  attemptId: string;
  missionId: string;
  missionVersion: number;
  codeHash: string;
  startedAt: number;
  durationMs: number;
  outcome: AttemptOutcome;
}

export interface ObjectiveResultRecord {
  attemptId: string;
  missionId: string;
  missionVersion: number;
  objectiveId: string;
  status: 'pass' | 'fail';
  code?: string;
}

export interface HintEventRecord {
  id?: number;
  missionId: string;
  missionVersion: number;
  hintId: string;
  objectiveId?: string;
  shownAt: number;
}

export interface ExportStores {
  meta: MetaRecord[];
  missions: MissionRecord[];
  attempts: AttemptRecord[];
  objectiveResults: ObjectiveResultRecord[];
  hintEvents: HintEventRecord[];
}

export const STORE_NAMES = [
  'meta',
  'missions',
  'attempts',
  'objectiveResults',
  'hintEvents',
] as const satisfies readonly (keyof ExportStores)[];

export function emptyStores(): ExportStores {
  return {
    meta: [],
    missions: [],
    attempts: [],
    objectiveResults: [],
    hintEvents: [],
  };
}
```

```ts
// apps/docs/components/academy/store.ts
import { emptyStores, STORE_NAMES, type ExportStores } from './records';

export const DB_NAME = 'nexusdi-academy';
export const SCHEMA_VERSION = 1;

export const BLOCKED_MESSAGE =
  'Close the other Academy tabs to finish updating.';
export const NOT_SAVING_MESSAGE =
  'This browser is not saving Academy progress. Missions still run, and your code stays until you leave the page.';

export type SchemaStep = (db: IDBDatabase, tx: IDBTransaction) => void;

/**
 * One additive step per schema version. A step adds a store or an index and
 * never rewrites a record (spec §13.6), so a database written by any earlier
 * version reads back unchanged.
 */
export const SCHEMA_STEPS: Record<number, SchemaStep> = {
  1: (db) => {
    db.createObjectStore('meta', { keyPath: 'key' });
    db.createObjectStore('missions', { keyPath: 'missionId' });

    const attempts = db.createObjectStore('attempts', { keyPath: 'attemptId' });
    attempts.createIndex('missionId', 'missionId');
    attempts.createIndex('missionVersion', ['missionId', 'missionVersion']);

    const results = db.createObjectStore('objectiveResults', {
      keyPath: ['attemptId', 'objectiveId'],
    });
    results.createIndex('objective', [
      'missionId',
      'missionVersion',
      'objectiveId',
    ]);

    const hints = db.createObjectStore('hintEvents', {
      keyPath: 'id',
      autoIncrement: true,
    });
    hints.createIndex('missionVersion', ['missionId', 'missionVersion']);
  },
};

export interface OpenOptions {
  name?: string;
  version?: number;
  steps?: Record<number, SchemaStep>;
  onBlocked?: () => void;
}

export interface ProgressStore {
  readAll(): Promise<ExportStores>;
  close(): void;
}

export function request<T>(pending: IDBRequest<T>): Promise<T> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    pending.onsuccess = () => resolve(pending.result);
    pending.onerror = () => reject(pending.error);
  });
}

export function completion(tx: IDBTransaction): Promise<void> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    tx.oncomplete = () => resolve();
    tx.onerror = () => reject(tx.error);
    tx.onabort = () =>
      reject(tx.error ?? new DOMException('Aborted', 'AbortError'));
  });
}

export function openDatabase(options: OpenOptions = {}): Promise<IDBDatabase> {
  const name = options.name ?? DB_NAME;
  const version = options.version ?? SCHEMA_VERSION;
  const steps = options.steps ?? SCHEMA_STEPS;

  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const open = indexedDB.open(name, version);

    open.onupgradeneeded = (event) => {
      const db = open.result;
      const tx = open.transaction as IDBTransaction;

      for (let at = event.oldVersion + 1; at <= version; at += 1) {
        const step = steps[at];
        if (!step) {
          tx.abort();
          reject(
            new Error(`The Academy schema has no step for version ${at}.`),
          );
          return;
        }
        step(db, tx);
      }

      const meta = tx.objectStore('meta');
      const current = meta.get('schema');
      current.onsuccess = () => {
        meta.put({
          key: 'schema',
          version,
          createdAt: current.result?.createdAt ?? Date.now(),
        });
      };
    };

    open.onblocked = () => options.onBlocked?.();
    open.onerror = () => reject(open.error);
    open.onsuccess = () => {
      const db = open.result;
      // An upgrade in another tab must never wait on this one.
      db.onversionchange = () => db.close();
      resolve(db);
    };
  });
}

function idbStore(db: IDBDatabase): ProgressStore {
  return {
    async readAll() {
      const tx = db.transaction([...STORE_NAMES], 'readonly');
      const read = await Promise.all(
        STORE_NAMES.map((store) => request(tx.objectStore(store).getAll())),
      );
      const stores = emptyStores();
      STORE_NAMES.forEach((store, at) => {
        (stores[store] as unknown[]) = read[at] as unknown[];
      });
      return stores;
    },
    close() {
      db.close();
    },
  };
}

export async function openProgress(
  options: OpenOptions = {},
): Promise<ProgressStore> {
  return idbStore(await openDatabase(options));
}

export function memoryStore(): ProgressStore {
  const stores = emptyStores();
  return {
    async readAll() {
      return structuredClone(stores);
    },
    close() {},
  };
}

function reasonOf(error: unknown): string {
  if (error instanceof DOMException || error instanceof Error)
    return error.name;
  return 'UnknownError';
}

/**
 * The persistent store when IndexedDB opens, and a memory store with the
 * reason otherwise. The Academy shows NOT_SAVING_MESSAGE on `persistent: false`.
 */
export async function openProgressOrMemory(options: OpenOptions = {}): Promise<{
  store: ProgressStore;
  persistent: boolean;
  reason: string | null;
}> {
  if (typeof indexedDB === 'undefined') {
    return { store: memoryStore(), persistent: false, reason: 'Unavailable' };
  }
  try {
    return {
      store: await openProgress(options),
      persistent: true,
      reason: null,
    };
  } catch (error) {
    return { store: memoryStore(), persistent: false, reason: reasonOf(error) };
  }
}
```

```ts
// apps/docs/components/academy/code-hash.ts
// NUL cannot appear in a file path, so a path never runs into its contents.
const SEPARATOR = '\u0000';

/** SHA-256 of the reader's files, joined in path order, as lowercase hex. */
export async function codeHash(files: Record<string, string>): Promise<string> {
  const joined = Object.keys(files)
    .sort()
    .map((path) => `${path}${SEPARATOR}${files[path]}`)
    .join(SEPARATOR);
  const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest(
    'SHA-256',
    new TextEncoder().encode(joined),
  );
  return [...new Uint8Array(digest)]
    .map((byte) => byte.toString(16).padStart(2, '0'))
    .join('');
}
```

In `apps/docs/components/academy/store.ts`, add the imports and replace `ProgressStore`, `idbStore` and `memoryStore`:

```ts
import {
  emptyStores,
  STORE_NAMES,
  type AttemptRecord,
  type ExportStores,
  type HintEventRecord,
  type MissionRecord,
  type ObjectiveResultRecord,
} from './records';

export interface ProgressStore {
  openMission(missionId: string, at: number): Promise<void>;
  saveCode(
    missionId: string,
    files: Record<string, string>,
    hash: string,
    passedVersion?: number,
  ): Promise<void>;
  recordAttempt(
    attempt: AttemptRecord,
    results: ObjectiveResultRecord[],
  ): Promise<void>;
  recordHint(event: Omit<HintEventRecord, 'id'>): Promise<void>;
  readAll(): Promise<ExportStores>;
  close(): void;
}

function checkResults(
  attempt: AttemptRecord,
  results: ObjectiveResultRecord[],
): void {
  const foreign = results.find((each) => each.attemptId !== attempt.attemptId);
  if (foreign) {
    throw new Error(
      `An objective result for attempt ${foreign.attemptId} was recorded with attempt ${attempt.attemptId}.`,
    );
  }
}

function nextMission(
  current: MissionRecord | undefined,
  missionId: string,
  files: Record<string, string>,
  hash: string,
  passedVersion: number | undefined,
): MissionRecord {
  const base: MissionRecord = current ?? {
    missionId,
    firstOpenedAt: Date.now(),
    lastCode: {},
    lastCodeHash: '',
  };
  return {
    ...base,
    lastCode: files,
    lastCodeHash: hash,
    ...(passedVersion === undefined
      ? {}
      : { passedCode: files, passedVersion }),
  };
}

function idbStore(db: IDBDatabase): ProgressStore {
  return {
    async openMission(missionId, at) {
      const tx = db.transaction('missions', 'readwrite');
      const missions = tx.objectStore('missions');
      const current = await request<MissionRecord | undefined>(
        missions.get(missionId),
      );
      if (!current) {
        missions.put({
          missionId,
          firstOpenedAt: at,
          lastCode: {},
          lastCodeHash: '',
        });
      }
      await completion(tx);
    },
    async saveCode(missionId, files, hash, passedVersion) {
      const tx = db.transaction('missions', 'readwrite');
      const missions = tx.objectStore('missions');
      const current = await request<MissionRecord | undefined>(
        missions.get(missionId),
      );
      missions.put(nextMission(current, missionId, files, hash, passedVersion));
      await completion(tx);
    },
    async recordAttempt(attempt, results) {
      checkResults(attempt, results);
      const tx = db.transaction(['attempts', 'objectiveResults'], 'readwrite');
      tx.objectStore('attempts').put(attempt);
      for (const each of results) tx.objectStore('objectiveResults').put(each);
      await completion(tx);
    },
    async recordHint(event) {
      const tx = db.transaction('hintEvents', 'readwrite');
      tx.objectStore('hintEvents').add(event);
      await completion(tx);
    },
    async readAll() {
      const tx = db.transaction([...STORE_NAMES], 'readonly');
      const read = await Promise.all(
        STORE_NAMES.map((store) => request(tx.objectStore(store).getAll())),
      );
      const stores = emptyStores();
      STORE_NAMES.forEach((store, at) => {
        (stores[store] as unknown[]) = read[at] as unknown[];
      });
      return stores;
    },
    close() {
      db.close();
    },
  };
}

export function memoryStore(): ProgressStore {
  const stores = emptyStores();
  let hintId = 0;

  return {
    async openMission(missionId, at) {
      if (!stores.missions.some((each) => each.missionId === missionId)) {
        stores.missions.push({
          missionId,
          firstOpenedAt: at,
          lastCode: {},
          lastCodeHash: '',
        });
      }
    },
    async saveCode(missionId, files, hash, passedVersion) {
      const at = stores.missions.findIndex(
        (each) => each.missionId === missionId,
      );
      const next = nextMission(
        stores.missions[at],
        missionId,
        files,
        hash,
        passedVersion,
      );
      if (at === -1) stores.missions.push(next);
      else stores.missions[at] = next;
    },
    async recordAttempt(attempt, results) {
      checkResults(attempt, results);
      stores.attempts = [
        ...stores.attempts.filter(
          (each) => each.attemptId !== attempt.attemptId,
        ),
        attempt,
      ];
      for (const each of results) {
        stores.objectiveResults = [
          ...stores.objectiveResults.filter(
            (held) =>
              held.attemptId !== each.attemptId ||
              held.objectiveId !== each.objectiveId,
          ),
          each,
        ];
      }
    },
    async recordHint(event) {
      hintId += 1;
      stores.hintEvents.push({ ...event, id: hintId });
    },
    async readAll() {
      return structuredClone(stores);
    },
    close() {},
  };
}
```

```ts
// apps/docs/components/academy/figures.ts
import type { ExportStores } from './records';

export interface MissionFigures {
  attempts: number;
  timeSpentMs: number;
  hintsUsed: number;
  objectives: Record<string, 'pass' | 'fail'>;
  timeToFirstPassMs: number | null;
  attemptsBeforePass: number | null;
  hintsBeforePass: number | null;
}

/**
 * The figures the Academy shows for one mission at one version, derived from
 * the event stores on every render. Nothing here is stored, so a figure added
 * later reads the same records (spec §13.6).
 */
export function missionFigures(
  stores: ExportStores,
  missionId: string,
  version: number,
): MissionFigures {
  const ours = (record: { missionId: string; missionVersion: number }) =>
    record.missionId === missionId && record.missionVersion === version;

  const attempts = stores.attempts
    .filter(ours)
    .sort((a, b) => a.startedAt - b.startedAt);
  const hints = stores.hintEvents.filter(ours);
  const newest = attempts.at(-1);

  const objectives: Record<string, 'pass' | 'fail'> = {};
  if (newest) {
    for (const each of stores.objectiveResults) {
      if (each.attemptId === newest.attemptId)
        objectives[each.objectiveId] = each.status;
    }
  }

  const passAt = attempts.findIndex((each) => each.outcome === 'pass');
  const pass = passAt === -1 ? null : attempts[passAt];
  const sum = (list: { durationMs: number }[]) =>
    list.reduce((total, each) => total + each.durationMs, 0);

  return {
    attempts: attempts.length,
    timeSpentMs: sum(attempts),
    hintsUsed: hints.length,
    objectives,
    timeToFirstPassMs: pass ? sum(attempts.slice(0, passAt + 1)) : null,
    attemptsBeforePass: pass ? passAt : null,
    hintsBeforePass: pass
      ? hints.filter((each) => each.shownAt < pass.startedAt).length
      : null,
  };
}
```

- [ ] Step 5: Implement export and reset

```ts
// apps/docs/components/academy/export.ts
import type { ExportStores } from './records';
import { DB_NAME } from './store';

export const EXPORT_FILE = 'nexusdi-academy-progress.json';

export interface ProgressExport {
  format: 'nexusdi-academy-export';
  version: 1;
  exportedAt: string;
  stores: ExportStores;
}

export function exportDocument(
  stores: ExportStores,
  now: Date,
): ProgressExport {
  return {
    format: 'nexusdi-academy-export',
    version: 1,
    exportedAt: now.toISOString(),
    stores,
  };
}

/**
 * The only path by which progress leaves the browser, and the reader starts
 * it (spec §13.8).
 */
export function downloadExport(
  document_: ProgressExport,
  host: Document = document,
): void {
  const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(document_, null, 2)], {
    type: 'application/json',
  });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const link = host.createElement('a');
  link.href = url;
  link.download = EXPORT_FILE;
  host.body.append(link);
  link.click();
  link.remove();
  setTimeout(() => URL.revokeObjectURL(url), 0);
}

export function resetProgress(name: string = DB_NAME): Promise<void> {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const request = indexedDB.deleteDatabase(name);
    request.onsuccess = () => resolve();
    request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
  });
}
```

- [ ] Step 6: Implement persistence

```ts
// apps/docs/components/academy/persist.ts
function available(
  storage: StorageManager | undefined,
): storage is StorageManager {
  return (
    storage !== undefined &&
    typeof storage.persisted === 'function' &&
    typeof storage.persist === 'function'
  );
}

function defaultStorage(): StorageManager | undefined {
  return typeof navigator === 'undefined' ? undefined : navigator.storage;
}

/**
 * Asks the browser to keep Academy progress. The Academy calls this when a
 * reader first runs a check (spec §13.7). A browser that already persists the
 * site is not asked again.
 */
export async function requestPersistence(
  storage: StorageManager | undefined = defaultStorage(),
): Promise<boolean | null> {
  if (!available(storage)) return null;
  if (await storage.persisted()) return true;
  return storage.persist();
}

export async function readPersistence(
  storage: StorageManager | undefined = defaultStorage(),
): Promise<boolean | null> {
  if (!available(storage)) return null;
  return storage.persisted();
}

export function describePersistence(persisted: boolean | null): string {
  if (persisted === true) {
    return 'This browser keeps Academy progress until you clear site data.';
  }
  if (persisted === false) {
    return 'This browser may delete Academy progress when storage runs low, or after seven days without a visit in Safari.';
  }
  return 'This browser does not report whether it keeps Academy progress.';
}
```

- [ ] Step 3: Implement the component

```tsx
// apps/docs/components/academy/ProgressPage.tsx
'use client';

import { Notice, Panel } from '@nexusdi/meridian-ui';
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';

import { downloadExport, exportDocument, resetProgress } from './export';
import { describePersistence, readPersistence } from './persist';
import {
  BLOCKED_MESSAGE,
  NOT_SAVING_MESSAGE,
  openProgressOrMemory,
  type ProgressStore,
} from './store';

interface Opened {
  store: ProgressStore;
  persistent: boolean;
}

export default function ProgressPage() {
  const [opened, setOpened] = useState<Opened | null>(null);
  const [blocked, setBlocked] = useState(false);
  const [persisted, setPersisted] = useState<boolean | null | undefined>(
    undefined,
  );
  const dialog = useRef<HTMLDialogElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    let live = true;
    let held: ProgressStore | null = null;

    openProgressOrMemory({ onBlocked: () => setBlocked(true) }).then(
      (result) => {
        if (!live) {
          result.store.close();
          return;
        }
        held = result.store;
        setBlocked(false);
        setOpened(result);
      },
    );
    readPersistence().then((value) => {
      if (live) setPersisted(value);
    });

    return () => {
      live = false;
      held?.close();
    };
  }, []);

  async function onExport() {
    if (!opened) return;
    downloadExport(exportDocument(await opened.store.readAll(), new Date()));
  }

  async function onConfirmReset() {
    opened?.store.close();
    if (opened?.persistent) await resetProgress();
    window.location.reload();
  }

  return (
    <Panel as="section" className="nexus-progress">
      <h1>Academy progress</h1>
      <p>
        Academy progress lives only in this browser. Export it to keep a copy.
      </p>
      {persisted !== undefined && (
        <p data-testid="storage-state">{describePersistence(persisted)}</p>
      )}
      {opened && !opened.persistent && (
        <Notice kind="warning">{NOT_SAVING_MESSAGE}</Notice>
      )}
      {blocked && <Notice kind="warning">{BLOCKED_MESSAGE}</Notice>}
      <div className="nexus-progress__actions">
        <button type="button" onClick={onExport} disabled={!opened}>
          Export
        </button>
        <button type="button" onClick={() => dialog.current?.showModal()}>
          Reset
        </button>
      </div>
      <dialog ref={dialog} aria-labelledby="nexus-reset-title">
        <form method="dialog">
          <h2 id="nexus-reset-title">Reset Academy progress?</h2>
          <p>
            Reset deletes every attempt, hint and saved file in this browser.
            Export first to keep a copy.
          </p>
          <button type="submit" value="cancel">
            Cancel
          </button>
          <button type="button" onClick={onConfirmReset}>
            Delete progress
          </button>
        </form>
      </dialog>
    </Panel>
  );
}
```

```ts
// apps/docs-e2e/src/progress.spec.ts
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';

import { expect, test } from '@playwright/test';

const PAGE = '/next/academy/progress/';
const NOT_SAVING =
  'This browser is not saving Academy progress. Missions still run, and your code stays until you leave the page.';

async function ready(page: import('@playwright/test').Page) {
  await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Export' })).toBeEnabled();
}

test('states where progress lives and whether the browser keeps it', async ({
  page,
}) => {
  await page.goto(PAGE);
  await expect(
    page.getByText(
      'Academy progress lives only in this browser. Export it to keep a copy.',
    ),
  ).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByTestId('storage-state')).toHaveText(
    /Academy progress/,
  );
});

test('shows the notice and keeps working when indexedDB.open throws', async ({
  page,
}) => {
  await page.addInitScript(() => {
    IDBFactory.prototype.open = () => {
      throw new DOMException('Blocked by the test', 'SecurityError');
    };
  });
  await page.goto(PAGE);

  await expect(page.getByText(NOT_SAVING)).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Export' })).toBeEnabled();
  await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Reset' })).toBeVisible();
});

test('exports the documented JSON', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto(PAGE);
  await ready(page);

  const [download] = await Promise.all([
    page.waitForEvent('download'),
    page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Export' }).click(),
  ]);

  expect(download.suggestedFilename()).toBe('nexusdi-academy-progress.json');
  const body = JSON.parse(
    readFileSync((await download.path()) as string, 'utf8'),
  );
  expect(body).toMatchObject({ format: 'nexusdi-academy-export', version: 1 });
  expect(Object.keys(body.stores).sort()).toEqual([
    'attempts',
    'hintEvents',
    'meta',
    'missions',
    'objectiveResults',
  ]);
});

test('reset empties the stores after the confirmation dialog', async ({
  page,
}) => {
  await page.goto(PAGE);
  await ready(page);

  await page.evaluate(
    () =>
      new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
        const open = indexedDB.open('nexusdi-academy', 1);
        open.onsuccess = () => {
          const tx = open.result.transaction('attempts', 'readwrite');
          tx.objectStore('attempts').put({
            attemptId: 'e2e',
            missionId: '01-first-light',
            missionVersion: 1,
            codeHash: 'x',
            startedAt: 1,
            durationMs: 1,
            outcome: 'fail',
          });
          tx.oncomplete = () => {
            open.result.close();
            resolve();
          };
          tx.onerror = () => reject(tx.error);
        };
      }),
  );

  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Reset' }).click();
  await expect(page.getByRole('dialog')).toBeVisible();
  await Promise.all([
    page.waitForEvent('load'),
    page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Delete progress' }).click(),
  ]);
  await ready(page);

  const attempts = await page.evaluate(
    () =>
      new Promise<number>((resolve) => {
        const open = indexedDB.open('nexusdi-academy', 1);
        open.onsuccess = () => {
          const count = open.result
            .transaction('attempts')
            .objectStore('attempts')
            .count();
          count.onsuccess = () => {
            open.result.close();
            resolve(count.result);
          };
        };
      }),
  );
  expect(attempts).toBe(0);
});
```

- [ ] Step 4: Write the region

The region is spec §5.3's Getting started path. `await using` at the top level of a module disposes the container when the module finishes, so the run's trace ends with the reactor's `dispose:instance` event. The region exports nothing: a top-level `await using` binding cannot be exported, and a Playground run reads the posted graph and trace.

```ts
// examples/meridian/src/playground/first-ship/main.ts
// #region first-ship
import { defineModule, Nexus, provide } from '@nexusdi/core';

export class ReactorCore {
  output = 1.21;

  async [Symbol.asyncDispose]() {
    // Drop the control rods.
  }
}

export class ShipComputer {
  constructor(readonly reactor: ReactorCore) {}
}

export const Meridian = defineModule({
  name: 'Meridian',
  providers: [ReactorCore, provide(ShipComputer, { deps: [ReactorCore] })],
});

await using ship = await Nexus.create(Meridian);

console.log(ship.get(ShipComputer).reactor.output);
// #endregion first-ship
```

- [ ] Step 9: Write the engine e2e test

The test records every message the sandbox posts to the page, so it checks the protocol and depends on no view markup.

```ts
// apps/docs-e2e/src/playground-engine.spec.ts
import { expect, test } from '@playwright/test';

test('a Playground run posts the graph and trace of the engine build', async ({
  page,
}) => {
  await page.addInitScript(() => {
    const seen: unknown[] = [];
    (window as unknown as { __runMessages: unknown[] }).__runMessages = seen;
    window.addEventListener('message', (event) => seen.push(event.data));
  });
  await page.goto('/next/playground/?seed=playground/first-ship');

  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Run' }).click();

  await expect
    .poll(() =>
      page.evaluate(() =>
        (
          window as unknown as { __runMessages: { type?: string }[] }
        ).__runMessages.some((message) => message?.type === 'done'),
      ),
    )
    .toBe(true);

  const messages = await page.evaluate(
    () =>
      (window as unknown as { __runMessages: Record<string, unknown>[] })
        .__runMessages,
  );
  const graph = messages.find((message) => message.type === 'graph') as
    { graph: { providers: { token: string }[] } } | undefined;
  const constructs = messages.filter(
    (message) =>
      message.type === 'trace' &&
      (message.event as { type: string }).type === 'construct',
  );

  expect(
    graph?.graph.providers.map((provider) => provider.token).sort(),
  ).toEqual(['ReactorCore', 'ShipComputer']);
  expect(constructs).toHaveLength(2);
  expect(messages.some((message) => message.type === 'error')).toBe(false);
});
```

## Group R: Before the first rc deploy

Phase 1 deploys in `snapshot-only` mode. This task runs before the pull request that sets `deploy.json` to `rc` (spec §18.2), so the e2e suite runs against the artifact layout that deploy produces. No Phase 1 task depends on it.

### Task 69: End-to-end tests against an `rc` artifact

Files:

- Create: `apps/docs-e2e/fixtures/snapshot-root/index.html`
- Create: `apps/docs-e2e/fixtures/snapshot-root/404.html`
- Create: `apps/docs-e2e/fixtures/snapshot-root/blog/rss.xml`
- Create: `apps/docs-e2e/fixtures/snapshot-root/blog/atom.xml`
- Modify: `apps/docs-e2e/src/support/build-site.mjs` (replace its contents)
- Test: `apps/docs-e2e/src/not-found.spec.ts`

Interfaces:

- Consumes: `assemble({ mode, site, nextOut, snapshotRoot, probe })` (Task 40); `apps/docs/out` from `npx nx build @nexusdi/docs` plus `npm run postbuild` (Tasks 2, 13, 24); `pages-server.mjs` (Task 3), which serves `apps/docs-e2e/.site/` on port 4310 and answers a missing path with the root `404.html` and status 404; the probe directory `apps/docs-e2e/probe/sandbox/` (Task 43).
- Produces: `build-site.mjs` laying out an `rc` artifact, with the probe when `SANDBOX_PROBE=1`.

- [ ] Step 2: Replace `build-site.mjs` so e2e runs against an `rc` artifact

```js
// apps/docs-e2e/src/support/build-site.mjs
import { execFileSync } from 'node:child_process';
import { join } from 'node:path';

import { assemble } from '../../../docs/tools/deploy/assemble.mjs';

/**
 * Builds the /next/ site and lays it out the way the rc deploy does: a
 * snapshot at the root (a fixture here) and the new site under next/, with
 * the root 404 script. The suite then runs against what GitHub Pages serves.
 * `SKIP_DOCS_BUILD=1` reuses apps/docs/out from a previous build.
 */
const root = join(import.meta.dirname, '..', '..', '..', '..');
const docs = join(root, 'apps', 'docs');
const e2e = join(root, 'apps', 'docs-e2e');

if (process.env.SKIP_DOCS_BUILD !== '1') {
  const env = { ...process.env, DOCS_BASE_PATH: '/next', DOCS_CHANNEL: 'next' };
  execFileSync('npx', ['nx', 'build', '@nexusdi/docs'], {
    cwd: root,
    env,
    stdio: 'inherit',
  });
  execFileSync('npm', ['run', 'postbuild'], {
    cwd: docs,
    env,
    stdio: 'inherit',
  });
}

const { files } = assemble({
  mode: 'rc',
  site: join(e2e, '.site'),
  nextOut: join(docs, 'out'),
  snapshotRoot: join(e2e, 'fixtures', 'snapshot-root'),
  probe:
    process.env.SANDBOX_PROBE === '1'
      ? join(e2e, 'probe', 'sandbox')
      : undefined,
});

console.log(`apps/docs-e2e/.site holds ${files} files`);
```

The `probe` line reads `apps/docs-e2e/probe/sandbox/`, which Task 43 created; with `SANDBOX_PROBE` unset it passes `undefined`.

```ts
// apps/docs-e2e/src/not-found.spec.ts
import { expect, test } from '@playwright/test';

test.describe('the root 404 page during the RC', () => {
  test('sends a missing /next/ path to the new site 404 page', async ({
    page,
  }) => {
    await page.goto('/next/this-page-does-not-exist/');
    await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/next\/404\.html$/);
    await expect(page.getByText('Snapshot 404 fixture')).toHaveCount(0);
  });

  test('keeps the 0.3 404 page for a missing root path', async ({ page }) => {
    const response = await page.goto('/this-page-does-not-exist/');
    expect(response?.status()).toBe(404);
    await expect(page.getByText('Snapshot 404 fixture')).toBeVisible();
  });
});
```
